listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Rose Essentielle Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: With the Rose Essentielle eau de parfum spray Bvlgari has created a women’s fragrance that pairs femininity with a dominant self-eloquence. The eau de parfum spray stands for the modern, balanced and fashion-conscious woman who knows what she wants. The sophisticated quality of the women’s fragrance can already be recognised from the flaçon. Its sophisticated design reflects the many high-quality ingredients. A women’s fragrance with accomplished characteristics Rose Essentielle was created on the basis of two flowers: Rose Prelude and Rose Ottomane. Whilst the first one stands for sensuality, confidence and femininity, the second rose convinces with its light, balanced aromas. Mimosa and jasmine give the fragrance a high degree of freshness. Fruity notes of violet and blackberries refine the fragrance composition and give it that special something. Quite simply a masterpiece from Bvlgari!

listings.description: The Baldessarini Uomo Eau de Toilette is a composition based on the interplay of fresh and warm notes. The fragrance opens with an invigorating top note that combines the sparkling freshness of bergamot with the spicy accents of black pepper, cardamom and ginger. The blue glass bottle with a silver-coloured cap emphasises the clear and stylish character of the fragrance. A composition of fresh, spicy and woody notes. listings.rawTitle: Baldessarini Bella Eau de Parfum Spray Absolue 30 ml
listings.description: With a lively combination of fruity and floral notes, the Bella Absolu eau de parfum spray from Baldessarini is a multi-faceted composition. The opening is extremely sparkling with accords of blackcurrant and pink grapefruit, while subtle nuances of yellow mandarin and marigold complement the fruity interplay and ensure a fresh start. A rich, floral bouquet unfolds in the heart of the creation, which significantly characterises the fragrance. This is where classic rose and intense rose absolute meet the elegant tones of gardenia, giving the whole a floral depth. The base note, which combines cool, aquatic elements with warm musk, provides a harmonious finish. Orcanox also contributes to a consistent and rounded finish. Visually, the bottle emphasises the impression of the contents with a rectangular, transparent glass in a delicate shade of pink that reveals the liquid. A silver, cylindrical cap and the stylised label on the front round off the design. This composition is part of the floral-citrus family of fragrances and focuses on a balanced interplay of freshness and floral accents. Fragrance family: Floral-citrusy orientation with musky and aquatic undertones. Top notes: Fruity interplay of blackcurrant, pink grapefruit, mandarin and marigold. Heart note: Floral bouquet of rose, rose absolute and gardenia. Base note: Rounded off with musk, aquatic notes and orcanox. Design: Rectangular glass bottle in pink with silver cap.

listings.rawTitle: Baldessarini Ultimate Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Ultimate by Baldessarini is a fragrance like a firework of the most elegant treasures of nature. The metallic and spicy freshness of Peruvian pepper combined with bergamot form a brilliant opening. Followed by masculine leather notes from labdanum resin, incense, ambergris and patchouli which work as a wonderful and unique contrast. Enjoy this extraordinary and masculine fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger Tommy Girl Eau de Toilette 30 ml
listings.description: Since its launch in the 1990s, this fragrance has established itself as a modern classic, renowned for its lively energy and carefree charm. The olfactory journey begins with a distinctly invigorating top note, in which the citrus freshness of bergamot and mandarin blends with the cool, crisp nuance of green mint. This invigorating opening sets the stage for a multifaceted heart, dominated by a lush bouquet of jasmine, rose and honeysuckle, whilst subtle tea accords lend an intriguing depth. The composition rounds off with a warm base of musk, ambergris and wild heather, lending the eau de toilette a gentle, lingering quality. The bottle’s design reflects the simplicity of its contents: A transparent, rectangular glass bottle with rounded corners reveals the slightly yellowish liquid. The appearance is enhanced by a cylindrical, silver-coloured cap and the distinctive red lettering on the front. As a floral-fruity creation, this spray offers a balanced blend of freshness and warmth that embodies the signature style of the Tommy Hilfiger brand. Fragrance family: Floral-fruity composition with a fresh character. Top notes: A combination of bergamot, mandarin and spearmint. Heart notes: A floral bouquet of jasmine, rose, honeysuckle and tea accords. Base note: A warm finish with musk, ambergris and wild heather. Bottle: Transparent, rectangular design with a silver cap and red lettering.

listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger Tommy Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Since its launch in 1995, Tommy Eau de Toilette Spray has epitomised a modern, aromatic classic. The composition starts with an invigorating freshness characterised by mint, lavender and tangy grapefruit, while bergamot provides a citrusy accent. An interesting heart note develops as the fragrance progresses, combining fruity Granny Smith apples and cranberries with the spice of cinnamon and nutmeg. This interplay is complemented by floral aspects of cactus blossom and rose. A warm and lasting finish is provided by the base note, which combines elements such as driftwood, maple and poplar with the softness of cotton and ambergris. This fragrance signature captures the atmosphere of a road trip through vast landscapes and symbolises independence. Visually, the rectangular, slightly rounded glass bottle with its "HILFIGER" and "EST. 1985" engravings on the sides and the blue lettering emphasise the timeless character of the brand. Fragrance: Fresh and aromatic with woody undertones. Head note: A combination of mint, lavender, grapefruit and bergamot. Heart note: Fruity accents of apple and cranberry meet cinnamon and cactus blossom. Base note: Warm nuances of driftwood, maple, poplar and cotton. Design: Classic glass bottle with silver cap and brand engraving.

listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger Freedom Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Tommy Hilfiger Freedom Eau de Parfum Spray offers a refreshing fragrance composition that adds a dynamic touch to everyday life. The ribbed glass bottle, with its striking red cap, is a stylish addition to any perfume collection. Fruity and floral notes blend to create a harmonious fragrance experience that leaves a pleasant lightness on the skin. Hints of apple blossom and mandarin open the fragrance, ensuring an invigorating start to the day. As the fragrance develops, floral notes such as jasmine unfold, lending the creation a timeless elegance. A base of cedarwood rounds the composition off, lending the scent a gentle depth. Thanks to its balanced formulation, the perfume can be worn effortlessly on a wide variety of occasions, whether at the office or in your free time. Just a few sprays are enough to create a long-lasting scent that subtly and unobtrusively enhances your personal presence. listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger Impact Together Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Tommy Hilfiger developed the eponymous brand with a connection to the USA in 1985. Since then, his focus has been on sporty and elegant products. Initially designing only fashion, he introduced his first perfume for men, "Tommy", in 1994. It remains a popular classic to this day and is considered a quality product on which his other fragrances are based. This also applies to the newly released Impact Together Eau de Toilette Spray. It is a men's perfume that elegantly emphasises nonchalance as a daytime fragrance and powerfully brings robust masculinity to the fore with intense spicy components. Tommy Hilfiger Impact Together for the purposeful, modern man This eau de toilette spray opens with an exciting tingle in the nose and a balsamic, spicy top note with pepper. Slightly spicy, the perfume radiates powerful energy - perfect for a successful, motivated start to the day . After a few moments, a woody and earthy note follows, paired with floral and smoky nuances of mugwort and sage. In combination, these heart notes give men a strongly masculine yet slightly playful aura that inspires and energises. A fascinating and motivating aroma emanates from vetiver as a base note. In Tommy Hilfiger Impact Together Eau de Toilette Spray, it exudes strongly smoky and woody fragrance components with undertones of earthy accents and a fine chocolate flavour. This creates an oriental odeur touch that beguiles the senses and creates a lasting, attractive impression .

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The power within. Burberry Goddess tells a story of self-discovery. The new campaign follows Emma Mackey and a pride of lionesses. With her confident, strong, friendly presence, Emma epitomises the spirit of Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum. This unique fragrance has a vegan formulation led by a powerful vanilla trio. Top notes of vanilla infusion with woody nuances, heart notes of vanilla caviar with luscious sweetness and base notes of vanilla absolute enriched with luminous lavender. Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum is contained in an elegant square bottle designed to be refilled. The refill is available separately. The pale pink packaging, decorated with a golden medallion, is a nod to the brand's rich tradition.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: In 2022, Burberry introduces the Eau de Parfum Spray Hero. The fragrance is sweet and woody and is intended for men. Created by perfumer Aurélien Guichard, however, it does not need a pyramid to develop its rather long-lasting presence. Pine needles meet benzoin, atlas cedar combines with Himalayan cedar and Virginia cedar before incense gently envelops everything. The composition of the Eau de Parfum Spray Hero not only has sweet and woody sides, but also resinous elements that prevent the fragrance from becoming too sweet. With Hero, Burberry presents an eau de parfum spray that breaks away a little from the label's well-known British understatement. Modern and casual, elegant Sweet men's fragrances are rarely found at Burberry, which makes this composition all the more exciting. Gentlemen who like it sweet and slightly resinous will get their money's worth with Hero. Especially because the fragrance develops into a really woody drydown over time. Burberry has once again proven that it has a good feel for elegant and timeless trends. And although the fragrance is sweet, it is also masculine , but with a conscious nonchalance , and does not impose itself, after all, it is an eau de parfum spray for the city, where it is often far too crowded and you don't want to wear expansive fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense Spray Refillable / 30 ml
listings.description: Discover the divine essence of femininity with the exquisite Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense Spray from Burberry. This extraordinary perfume is a tribute to the timeless elegance and inner strength of every woman. Its skilfully crafted bottle, which reflects the iconic Burberry design, conceals a fragrance that combines sensuality and sophistication in perfect harmony. Exclusive perfume from Burberry The olfactory experience begins with a gentle breeze of lavender in the top note. This calming opening envelops you in an aura of serenity and freshness, reminiscent of sun-soaked lavender fields in Provence. It is the perfect introduction to a fragrance journey that will enchant your senses. A seductive composition of warm, sweet vanilla unfolds at the heart of Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense Spray. This heart note gives the fragrance a creamy depth and a subtle sweetness reminiscent of golden honey and sun-warmed skin. The vanilla caresses your senses and envelops you in an aura of comfort and sensuality. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with earthy, sensual patchouli. This powerful note gives the perfume depth and character, while at the same time creating a mysterious, almost mystical aura. The patchouli is reminiscent of exotic lands and lends the fragrance an irresistible allure that lingers for a long time. Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense Spray is more than just a fragrance - it is an experience, a transformation. With its intense formulation, the fragrance lasts all day and into the night, perfect for special occasions or when you just want to feel like a goddess.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Burberry Hero is an eau de toilette spray for men launched in 2021. The fragrance is spicy and woody , the straightforward bottle was designed by Riccardo Tisci. Perfumer Aurèlien Guichard composed Hero without a fragrance pyramid. He blends cedar from Virginia, the Atlas Mountains and the Himalayas with spicy black pepper, aromatic juniper and resinous bergamot. Designed in this way, the Burberry Eau de Toilette Spray is masculine but not overpowering, elegant and expressive, yet at the same time refined and discreet. It is the perfect fragrance for everyday wear, where the well-groomed man of today wants to smell good but not overpowering. These heroes also score points in everyday life Hero is a men's fragrance that doesn't need a costume. Sporty and casual , elegant and wearable , the ideal companion for jeans and boots as well as a suit, the Hero eau de toilette spray from Burberry is just like the fashion of the popular British label. A touch of luxury that is evident in the quality and versatility, which does not play itself into the foreground, but is simply there. Very British, very gentlemanly. This fragrance is a real must-have, not just for die-hard Burberry fans, but for anyone who likes a strong yet discreet scent.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Perfume 150 ml
listings.description: With the Burberry Hero fragrance, the British designer house continues the success story of the eponymous fragrance range. The creation from 2024 combines balsamic, warm notes with smoky accents and a masculine, woody base . The result is a men's fragrance with a character that is as modern as it is elegant. Modern composition with a classic base The Burberry Hero fragrance opens with a top note dominated by cypriol oil. It sets a woody, earthy accent that is also reminiscent of leather. In the background, the heart note forms an exciting contrast with the warm, sweet and woody scent of amyris oil. The crowning glory of the composition is the base note of cedarwood, a classic ingredient for high-quality fragrances. This modern men's fragrance is perfect for making a statement. With its elegant charisma , it is perfect for the evening. It is equally at home at dinner, in a club or at special events. Burberry Hero perfume comes into its own in cooler weather thanks to its balsamic, woody character.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Parfum Intense 50 ml
listings.description: Experience the fascinating world of Burberry with Parfum Intense, an extraordinary eau de parfum from the Hero collection that redefines modern masculinity. In this masterful composition, natural strength and elegance merge to create a fragrance with a strong character that sets new standards in the world of woody men's fragrances. The fresh essence of pine unfolds in the top note right at the beginning, its clear, natural presence immediately evoking memories of a walk through a majestic coniferous forest. This intense freshness transitions seamlessly into the heart note, where the warm, balsamic sweetness of benzoin unfolds and lends the fragrance a seductive depth and oriental sophistication. Parfum Intense Eau de Parfum Spray - powerful elegance in perfection In the harmonious finale, the composition is carried by precious cedarwood, whose warm, woody nuances blend perfectly with the previous notes and create a long-lasting, masculine signature. This balanced fragrance pyramid creates an unmistakable aura of self-confidence and timeless elegance. The modern design of the Hero bottle with its clear lines and striking shape picks up on the strength of character of the fragrance and emphasises its intensity as an eau de parfum spray. This creates a holistic fragrance experience that lingers on the skin for a long time. Parfum Intense from the Hero collection by Burberry is the ideal companion for today's man who values quality and style . As a worthy representative of the renowned Burberry men's fragrances, it impresses both in a business environment and on special occasions with its expressive yet discreet presence.</p

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Elixir Eau de Parfume Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Burberry Her Elixir Eau de Parfume Spray was released in 2022 and enriches the popular Her fragrance range with a fruity gourmand . Its opaque, deep pink bottle cleverly embodies the fragrance's character: intense, sensual and creamy. The smooth, warm accords make it the perfect cosy fragrance for the cool season. However, its cheerful fruitiness gives Her Elixir a special twist . This also makes the fragrance an uncomplicated companion on warm spring days. Her Elixir - the intensifying flanker The fragrance DNA is closely related to the classic Burberry Her, but Her Elixir has a little more of everything: more creaminess, a pronounced powdery note and more powerful berry accords . These fruity notes dominate the eau de parfume spray at first spray. Strawberry and blackberry as the only top notes create a fresh sweetness in the opening. The heart consists of clear, minimalist and elegant pure jasmine. The result is a carefree, feminine fragrance full of sensuality and joie de vivre. In the dry down, the Burberry Eau de Parfume Spray ends with lush accords of warm vanilla and cosy sandalwood and amber - a composition made for women who like to push boundaries. But beware: you'll probably find it hard to save yourself from compliments.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Parfum Refillable 30 ml
listings.description: Discover Goddess Burberry, a luxurious fragrance composition that celebrates modern femininity in all its facets. This exquisite women's fragrance embodies the timeless elegance of the renowned British fashion house and combines classic sophistication with innovative sustainability thanks to its refillable concept. A heavenly perfume composition Goddess Burberry Refillable Perfume unfolds like a sensual promise on the skin. The first notes greet you with a radiant freshness that immediately awakens your senses. The heart of the fragrance reveals a fascinating floral bouquet of mesmerising intensity, while the base notes with their velvety warmth and depth leave a divine aftertaste that lingers on the skin for hours. Sustainable luxury The refillable design of this premium fragrance combines luxury with an environmentally conscious approach. The elegantly designed flacon is conceived as a valuable collector's item that can accompany you for a lifetime. The easily replaceable perfume refill allows you to enjoy your favourite fragrance again and again without having to sacrifice exclusive quality. For the confident goddess Goddess Burberry is created for the woman who wears her inner strength and beauty with confidence. This perfume is refillable and accompanies you confidently through all of life's situations. It gives you an irresistible aura of self-confidence and timeless elegance.</p

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Burberry Her Eau de Toilette Spray is a floral-fresh fragrance with fruity and green influences . The extravagant fragrance composition is suitable for women who want to emphasise their femininity and present themselves with confidence. Here, sensual sounds meet floral and sparkling notes. British model Fran Summers is the face of the perfume's advertising campaign. With her attractive, romantic and equally powerful charisma , she perfectly reflects the current zeitgeist and the direction of this perfume. The Her Eau de Toilette Spray by Burberry whets the appetite for more and envelops every woman in a cheerful, tender and extremely lively aura . A luxurious fragrance that invites you to dream In the top note, green bergamot, blackcurrant and pink pepper initially unfold their loving aromas. Honeysuckle, peony, rose and lily of the valley take the lead in the heart. In the base note, nuances of musk and cedar wood skilfully round off this unmistakable fragrance experience. Due to its lightness, Burberry Her Eau de Toilette Spray is particularly effective in the warmer seasons from spring to autumn . The minimalist and stylishly designed bottle made of solid glass with the atomiser placed on the side sets the scene for this fragrance in an appealing and tasteful way.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Eau de Parfum Intense Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Burberry Her Eau de Parfum Intense Spray takes the iconic fragrance of the traditional British brand and gives it a new, even more intense facet . It goes without saying that this perfume is perfect for anyone who already loves the classic creation for women. Like these, the Burberry Her Eau de Parfum Intense Spray uses a combination of oriental, powdery and fruity extracts to create a varied and multi-layered fragrance. The bottle, which comes in a beautiful pale pink, is also an eye-catcher - and is guaranteed to catch the eye in the bathroom at home. An intense, delicious and exclusive perfume for women The top note of Burberry Her Eau de Parfum Intense Spray opens with very striking and fruity extracts of strawberry. The heart note is also fruity, with floral accords dominating, with orange blossom standing out in particular. The base note uses amberwood to give the entire creation a subtle oriental and exotic touch. The overall fragrance, which is both warm and sparkling, is truly unique. The aura of luxury that this creation exudes from the first spritz is unmistakable - also very suitable for special occasions.</p

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau de Parfum Spray Eau So Extra 30 ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau So Extra Eau de Parfum unveils a multi-layered world of fragrance that accompanies everyday life with an inviting presence. The floral and gourmand notes are ideal for moments of relaxation as well as for special occasions. The scent of the real chocolate flower blends with creamy banana and fruity pear nectar to create a harmonious experience. Warm accents of vanilla and amber round off the profile and leave a lasting impression. Thanks to the high fragrance concentration, just a few sprays are enough to enjoy the composition for many hours, making it economical to use. The green glass bottle, with its cap adorned with colourful flower heads, reflects the character of the fragrance. When using the perfume, it is advisable to avoid contact with the eyes and to protect it from direct heat and flames. Floral gourmand fragrance with chocolate flower, banana and pear nectar Warm base notes of vanilla and amber for a long-lasting scent Intense Eau de Parfum concentration for economical use A versatile composition suitable for everyday wear and special occasions

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Love Eau de Toilette Spray Eau So Sweet 50 ml
listings.description: Daisy Love Eau So Sweet by Marc Jacobs is a fragrance that evokes sweet light-heartedness and youthful optimism. This composition pays homage to life’s carefree moments and captures a playful spirit, inspired by values such as sisterhood and joy. The fragrance opens with a zesty blend of white raspberry, fresh bergamot and crystallised cloudberries, creating a fruity first impression. At the heart, a delicate bouquet of daisy tree petals unfolds, accompanied by a hint of jasmine milk, lending the eau de toilette its floral character. The base note provides a warm and sensual depth, blending sugar musk with elegant white iris wood. listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Eau de Parfum Spray Just Perfect 30 ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Just Perfect Eau de Parfum adds a fruity, sweet scent to everyday life, leaving a pleasant impression. A fresh opening of strawberry accord, passion fruit, mandarin and raspberry offers a refreshing fragrance experience immediately after spraying. This zesty combination ensures a lively start to the morning. At its heart, the fragrance unfolds a harmonious blend of jasmine sambac, caramel, red apple and orange blossom petals. This heart note lends an elegant aura to your appearance, making it ideal for the office or a relaxed afternoon get-together. The base notes of vanilla absolute and amber sorbet round off the composition and ensure a warm finish. The fragrance thus reliably accompanies you well into the evening. The light blue bottle, with its striking white bow, is a stylish eye-catcher. The practical spray head allows for precise application of the eau de parfum. With its compact 30 ml size, it also fits effortlessly into any bag and offers a simple way to freshen up whilst out and about. listings.rawTitle: Chloé Chloé Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Chloé Eau de Parfum Spray is a modern and elegant interpretation of the classic rose, captured in a floral fragrance. The composition opens with a fresh top note of delicate pink peony, fruity lychee and airy freesia. At the heart of the fragrance, a delicate bouquet of magnolia and lily of the valley unfolds, giving way to a warm base. Notes of cedarwood, amber and a hint of honey lend the perfume its sensual, powdery and characterful finish. The overall result is a light and warm fragrance that combines French charm with a blend of floral notes and lively accents. The romantically designed bottle, inspired by the Chloé Fortune Plissé collection, emphasises the fragrance’s elegance. A silver-plated metal plate and a hand-tied beige bow complete the design. Its timeless appeal was recognised in 2024 with the Austrian Perfume Award in the ‘Classic Women’s Fragrances’ category. A floral fragrance offering a modern interpretation of the rose. A composition of peony, lychee, magnolia and cedarwood. A light, warm and powdery fragrance. An elegant pleated bottle with a hand-tied bow. Awarded “Women’s Classic” at the Austrian Perfume Awards 2024.

Here, neroli and zesty citrus notes of bergamot, grapefruit and lemon meet the gentle sweetness of pear. As the fragrance develops, the heart unfolds: a bouquet of orange blossom, Madagascar jasmine and classic rose. Fruity accents of blackcurrant and peach lend the heart note a distinctive dimension. The fragrance concludes with a warm base of musk, cedar, patchouli and cashmere wood, which lends the fragrance its enduring character. The fragrance is presented in an elegant, delicate golden bottle, whose design emphasises the perfume’s allure. A fresh, floral fragrance A composition with notes of neroli, orange blossom and cedar Inspired by a modern love story in Paris Presented in an elegant, delicate golden bottle

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Le Parfum Eau de Parfum Spray Refillable 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Le Parfum, a fragrance created in France by perfumer Romain Almairac, is an intense interpretation of the classic signature. The opening unfolds with a powerful accord of orange blossom, which immediately exudes a warm presence and appeals to the senses. This is followed in the heart by an essence of rose, which significantly shapes the structure of the fragrance and lends it an elegant character. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a base of vanilla and tonka bean, which lends the Eau de Parfum Spray a certain depth without becoming overly sweet. Visually, the product captivates with its iconic fluted glass bottle, which holds a light golden liquid and is crowned by a silver cap. A beige label and a hand-tied bow in a dark Bordeaux shade around the neck of the bottle add splashes of colour. The entire range is designed to be refillable in 30 ml, 50 ml and 100 ml sizes, promoting the responsible use of resources. For the nuances to unfold over time, we recommend applying it to pulse points such as the neck, décolleté or the insides of the wrists. Fragrance composition: Powerful orange blossom in the top note, combined with rose essence and a base of vanilla and tonka bean. Character: A warm, intense fragrance that makes a statement without being too sweet. Design: Iconic flacon made of ribbed glass with a silver cap and a burgundy bow. Sustainability: The Eau de Parfum spray is designed to be refillable. Origin: Created by perfumer Romain Almairac and manufactured in France.

listings.description: Chloé’s L’Eau de Parfum Intense Spray is an elegant and powerful women’s fragrance characterised by a multi-faceted composition. listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray Nuit d'Egypt 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Nomade Nuit d'Égypte pays homage to the origins of perfumery and offers a modern interpretation of humanity’s first fragrance: kyphi. Created by perfumer Juliette Karagueuzoglou, this composition takes you on a fascinating journey. The fragrance opens with powerful accents of myrrh, which blend harmoniously with the spicy notes of ginger and cinnamon. At the heart, a bouquet of broom blossom nectar and the opulent orange blossom absolute—sourced directly from the Nile Delta—unfolds. Warm, balsamic nuances of cypriol and opoponax round off the heart note, before a soft vanilla note in the base provides a long-lasting finish. The Eau de Parfum consists of 90 per cent ingredients of natural origin. The bottle is adorned with a ribbon in ‘Egyptian Blue’, one of the oldest man-made pigments, which emphasises the fragrance’s refined character. The packaging also consists partly of recycled materials. An amber-floral fragrance with an intense and sophisticated character. A composition featuring notes of myrrh, orange blossom absolute and vanilla. Contains 90 per cent ingredients of natural origin. Inspired by the formula of the ancient Egyptian Kyphi perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray Jasmin Naturelle 50 ml
listings.description: Chloé Nomade Jasmin Naturelle Eau de Parfum Spray is a fragrance inspired by the beauty of the world. At the heart of this feminine fragrance creation by perfumer Caroline Dumur lies Egyptian jasmine, responsibly hand-picked at sunrise. Its floral note blends in the heart with the gentle accent of date, whilst a base of warm vanilla and sandalwood lends a harmonious depth. The composition unfolds with a floral-spicy character and is characterised by a soft, elegant warmth that avoids any cloying sweetness. The formulation is vegan and consists of 100% naturally derived ingredients, with no artificial colourants. The bottle, in earthy ochre tones with a braided detail around the neck, reflects the fragrance’s cosmopolitan character. A feminine, floral-spicy fragrance A composition with notes of jasmine, date and vanilla Vegan formula made from 100% naturally derived ingredients Free from artificial colourings

listings.description: Chloé Lumineuse is an Eau de Parfum created by perfumer Ane Ayo. At the heart of the composition, a full-bodied and complex rose unfolds, elegantly accompanied by velvety notes of Arabian jasmine. A subtle hint of vanilla lends the floral bouquet a special depth, gently underscored by warm amber and balsamic accents. The fragrance’s vegan formula consists of naturally derived fragrances, alcohol and water. The perfume is housed in an elegant, fluted glass bottle in a vintage style. The perfume is also available as a 150 ml refill pack. A floral fragrance with notes of rose, jasmine and vanilla. Vegan formulation with naturally derived fragrances. listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray Jardin d’Égypte 30 ml
listings.description: As the third creation in the Nomade Égypte range, the Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray Jardin d’Égypte takes you on an olfactory journey to the homeland of the brand’s founder, Gaby Aghion. The composition by perfumer Caroline Dumur captures the atmosphere of a sun-drenched Egyptian garden, where ancient traditions blend with modern lightness. The opening notes immediately surprise with an unusual combination of the rare cassia flower and papyrus, lending the fragrance a green, almost mystical freshness. At the heart, a complex interplay of sweet dates and figs unfolds, meeting a spicy kyphi accord. This ancient incense blend, refined with notes of cinnamon and myrrh, lends a resinous depth that nevertheless remains airy. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a warm base of creamy sandalwood, ambrette and solarwood, which lingers on the skin for a long time. Visually, the bottle reflects the connection to nature. The distinctive glass bottle, with its rounded shapes, offers a view of the pale yellow liquid. A woven element frames the front, whilst a green band and a matching tassel on the golden cap add splashes of colour. The golden metal element bearing the lettering “NOMADE” completes the elegant look. Fragrance family: Woody-amber with floral and resinous facets. Top notes: Cassie flower and papyrus for a fresh opening. Heart notes: Date, fig and a spicy kyphi accord (cinnamon, myrrh). Base notes: Sandalwood, Solarwood and ambrette provide warmth. Design: Transparent bottle with green details and a braided rim.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray Lumière d'Égypte 30 ml
listings.description: The Nomade Lumière d'Égypte Eau de Parfum Spray pays homage to the majestic landscapes of Egypt. Inspired by a journey along the Nile, the fragrance opens with a floral and aquatic accord of blue lotus. This airy freshness gives way to a heart of velvety jasmine notes that unfold a sensual warmth. The fragrance concludes with a rich kyphi accord, a classic composition combining notes of cinnamon bark, sandalwood, myrrh, pink pepper and elemi oil. This blend creates a sophisticated fragrance composition that embodies fresh vegetation and the warmth of the desert. The iconic Nomade bottle emphasises the character of the fragrance with golden accents and an elegant blue-grey ribbon. Fragrance profile: Floral, warm Top note: Blue lotus accord Heart note: Jasmine Base note: Kyphi accord

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Chloé Eau de Parfum Spray Rose Naturelle Intense 50 ml
listings.description: Chloé Rose Naturelle Intense Eau de Parfum Spray is a modern and intense interpretation of the iconic rose. Created by perfumer Alexis Dadier, the composition is based entirely on ingredients of natural origin and contains no artificial additives whatsoever. It opens with a sweet, fresh note of bergamot, which gives way to a heart of pure neroli and the exquisite essence of organically grown rose. The base notes lend the fragrance its distinctive character: slightly smoky, upcycled oak wood meets creamy sandalwood and a hint of cedarwood. On the skin, this unfolds into a woody-rosy aroma with a velvety, creamy depth that deliberately sets itself apart from classic floral fragrances. This commitment to naturalness is also reflected in the packaging, which uses recycled materials for the bottle, ribbon and box. A modern, woody-rosy fragrance composition A vegan formula with ingredients of 100% natural origin Elegant heart note of organically grown rose and neroli Warm base note of creamy sandalwood and upcycled oakwood

Created by perfumer Alexis Dadier, the composition is based entirely on ingredients of natural origin and contains no artificial additives whatsoever. It opens with a sweet, fresh note of bergamot, which gives way to a heart of pure neroli and the exquisite essence of organically grown rose. The base notes lend the fragrance its distinctive character: slightly smoky, upcycled oak wood meets creamy sandalwood and a hint of cedarwood. On the skin, this unfolds into a woody-rosy aroma with a velvety, creamy depth that deliberately sets itself apart from classic floral fragrances. This commitment to naturalness is also reflected in the packaging, which uses recycled materials for the bottle, ribbon and box. A modern, woody-rosy fragrance composition A vegan formula with ingredients of 100% natural origin Elegant heart note of organically grown rose and neroli Warm base note of creamy sandalwood and upcycled oakwood

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Chloé Parfum Intense Spray Le Nectar Refill / 150 ml
listings.description: Chloé Le Nectar Parfum Intense offers a multi-faceted fragrance composition that perfectly enriches everyday life. The elegant glass bottle, with its ribbed texture and gold-coloured bow, blends stylishly into any perfume collection. A top note of bergamot opens the fragrance experience, creating an invigorating sensation the moment it is sprayed, perfect for starting the day. At the heart, neroli, orange blossom and rose unfold their floral facets, leaving a pleasant impression on special occasions or in the office. The base notes of tonka bean and patchouli round off the profile and provide a long-lasting depth, ensuring the fragrance remains noticeable for many hours. Thanks to its practical 30-millilitre size, the spray fits effortlessly into any handbag, making it easy to freshen up whilst out and about. Furthermore, the refillable system offers tangible added value, as users can simply reuse the bottle once it is empty. A multifaceted fragrance composition featuring bergamot, rose and patchouli for a long-lasting presence. The compact 30-ml size makes it easy to carry and refresh your fragrance throughout the day. The refillable design makes it easy to reuse the bottle. Versatile enough for both the office and special occasions.

The Eau de Parfum Spray from the Chloé brand emphasises the personality of its wearer and accentuates her feminine side. Simply a sensual delight! listings.description: The Chopard Wish Eau de Parfum Spray is a multi-faceted fragrance composition for women that has been inspiring since 1999. Captured in a bottle whose design is reminiscent of an artfully cut diamond, the outer appearance already reflects the character of the contents. The fragrance opens with a playful top note, in which fruity flavours of strawberry, pear and coconut combine with the delicate blossoms of honeysuckle and acacia. The heart of the fragrance then unfolds, a harmonious combination of floral notes such as violet and orchid, which is given a special depth by sweet accents of honey and milk. The base forms a long-lasting and warm finish. This is where creamy notes of vanilla, caramel and toffee meet the woody elegance of sandalwood and the sensuality of amber and incense. The result is a complex and feminine fragrance that leaves behind an unmistakable aura. A multi-faceted fragrance with floral and sweet notes. Iconic bottle in the design of a cut diamond. Composition of fruity, floral and warm gourmand accords. Created by perfumer Nathalie Lorson in 1999.

listings.description: The Eau de Toilette Spray Girl is presented by Rochas 2021. The floral and sweet fragrance is feminine and captivates with a mature yet romantic presence. Created by Anne Flipo and IFF, the top notes are neroli, pink pepper and blackcurrant. The heart note brings the flavours of orange blossom, jasmine and orchid. Woody notes appear in the base, with sandalwood and cedarwood complemented by vanilla. The result is a wonderful fragrance for spring and summer, when the temperatures slowly rise. The Eau de Toilette Spray Girl by Rochas is clearly perceptible, but not overpowering or heavy. This all-rounder is for you Girl is a women's fragrance that really always works. The eau de toilette spray scores just as well in your free time as it does at work, in the evening or when going out. No matter where you go, Rochas Girl will accompany you. After all, the fragrance is aimed at all women who go through life in a relaxed manner, who can laugh at themselves and who feel just as comfortable in jeans as they do in a dress. With this fragrance, you appear groomed and elegant , but also casual and casual . And because it is a Rochas Eau de Toilette, it also offers that certain luxury.

listings.description: The Eau de Rochas Eau de Toilette is a classic fragrance that has been a favourite since its launch in 1970. This composition pays homage to the invigorating freshness of waterfalls and unspoilt nature. The fragrance opens with a sparkling combination of mandarin, bergamot and lemon, which creates a clear and refreshing first impression. At the heart, a bouquet of narcissus, jasmine and rose unfolds, giving the fragrance a subtle floral depth. The base note rounds off the experience with oakmoss, myrrh and vetiver, leaving an earthy, slightly woody signature on the skin. The eau de toilette is presented in an elegant glass bottle, whose textured surface is reminiscent of flowing water and also visually reflects the fragrance experience. Fragrance direction: Citrus-fresh Head note: mandarin, bergamot, lemon Heart note: narcissus, jasmine, rose Base note: oakmoss, myrrh, vetiver Character: Invigorating and elegant

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Intuition Eau de Parfum Spray 10 ml
listings.description: With Intuition Eau de Parfum Spray, Aramis presents a modern evolution of the traditional art of fragrance, which is technically categorised as Woody Green Neo-Fougère. Launched in 2025, this creation skilfully combines green accents with a woody depth and stands for contemporary elegance. The olfactory opening is characterised by a crisp grapefruit note that lends the fragrance an immediate, citrusy clarity. Aromatic lavender then unfolds at the centre of the composition, creating a harmonious link to the more complex base notes as a classic element. The foundation of earthy vetiver and the special Cuirissima LXR, an exclusive accord that creates a warm and leathery signature, is particularly influential for the character of the perfume. Accompanying nuances of patchouli, amber and orris round off the fragrance experience and lend it a subtle persistence. Visually, the purity of the fragrance is reflected in a slim, cylindrical bottle made of transparent glass, which reveals the clear liquid. A silver cap and vertical lettering on the front complete the minimalist design. The projection of the eau de parfum changes from an initial freshness to a subtle, body-hugging warmth as it is worn. Fragrance family: Woody Green Neo-Fougère with woody and green facets. Top notes of tangy grapefruit and heart notes with aromatic lavender. Base note with earthy vetiver and exclusive Cuirissima LXR leather accord. Minimalist, cylindrical glass bottle with silver cap. Evolution from citrusy freshness to warm, leathery depth.

listings.description: Since its launch in 1996, Azzaro Chrome Eau de Toilette Spray has established itself as a timeless classic. At the heart of the fragrance, an aromatic interplay of jasmine, coriander and lichen unfolds, lending the creation a clear depth. The base note rounds off the olfactory experience with warm, woody accords of oak moss, sandalwood and cedar. Inspired by the intimate connection between generations, Chrome embodies an aquatic and pure fragrance character. Its light nature makes it a pleasant companion, especially on warm days. The design of the metallic blue bottle emphasises the freshness of the fragrance composition. An aromatic fragrance with fresh and woody notes. Composition of citrus fruits, spices and warm woods. listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Pour Homme Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Azzaro Pour Homme is a timeless classic men's fragrance that has been appreciated for its aromatic, woody fougère signature since 1978. The complex composition is based on a variety of ingredients, more than half of which are of natural origin. It opens with a fresh top note of lavender, citrus fruits and star anise. This is followed by an aromatic heart of notes such as cedar, cardamom and patchouli, which gives the fragrance its unmistakable character. In the base note, sandalwood, musk, amber and oakmoss combine to create a warm and deep base that emphasises the elegant yet sensual aura. As an eau de toilette, the fragrance has a moderate concentration, making it an ideal companion for every day. The perfume is presented in a striking, octagonal glass bottle with an amber-coloured tint that visually reflects the warmth of the fragrance composition and is also refillable. listings.description: L'Air du Temps by Nina Ricci is an iconic fragrance classic that was created by perfumer Francis Fabron in 1948. This floral-spicy composition unfolds with a lively top note of Italian bergamot, spicy clove oil, neroli and a hint of peach. At the heart of the creation is a harmonious bouquet of rose centifolia, jasmine from Grasse and gardenia, which is given a special sophistication by ylang-ylang and cloves. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with warm, gentle accords of sandalwood, iris, musk and cedarwood, giving the perfume a long-lasting depth. The fragrance is presented in an elegantly curved glass bottle with a cap crowned by two embracing doves - a timeless symbol of peace and love. With its elegant and feminine aura, L'Air du Temps is a versatile companion for any occasion. A timeless, floral-spicy fragrance classic. Composition of carnation, rose, jasmine and sandalwood. Elegant bottle with dove stopper as a symbol of peace. Character: feminine, elegant and long-lasting.

The Illusion Eau de Parfum Spray Nina by Nina Ricci is a perfume that inspires many modern women and many men. On the market since 2024 and as an interesting perfume as popular as tried-and-tested products. The effect of spices in combination with fruits and patchouli! Fragrance pyramid harmonises perfectly with the illusion The Illusion Eau de Parfum Spray proves just how important a well-harmonised fragrance pyramid is for the success of a perfume. The top note opens with fresh citrus scents and light spices. Sweet raspberry and fruity orange clearly define the heart note, while vanilla and patchouli create a pleasant, slightly exotic finish. Sesqui terpenes are responsible for relaxation and stimulation. The Nina Spray from Nina Ricci owes its spiritual effect to the ideal blend of natural ingredients. When the right components complement each other perfectly, as they do here, the result is fantastic!

listings.description: The Moschino Toy 2 Eau de Parfum Spray, created by perfumers Alberto Morillas and Fabrice Pellegrin, was launched in 2018. This fragrance for women belongs to the floral-woody musk family and has a multi-layered character. It opens with a lively top note of juicy mandarin and crisp Granny Smith apple, accompanied by the floral elegance of magnolia. At the heart of the composition, the delicacy of peony meets pure jasmine petals, whilst white currant adds a surprisingly fruity facet. The base note anchors the fragrance with warm tones. Here, sandalwood and amberwood combine with the gentle clarity of musk to create a harmonious finish. The Eau de Parfum is presented in a distinctive bottle that echoes the iconic shape of a teddy bear. A fragrance for women from the floral-woody musk family A lively opening with mandarin, apple and magnolia A warm base note of sandalwood, amberwood and musk Iconic bottle in an unmistakable teddy bear design

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy Boy Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Moschino’s Toy Boy Eau de Parfum Spray is a fragrance full of contrasts and playful elegance. Created by perfumer Yann Vasnier, this composition belongs to the spicy-woody fragrance family and surprises with floral and fruity notes. The opening unfolds with a lively blend of Italian bergamot, pear and the subtle heat of pink pepper and Indonesian nutmeg. This is followed by the heart note, in which a bouquet of magnolia, rose absolute and flax blossom blends with the spicy warmth of clove. The base note leaves a lasting impression, creating a warm, earthy depth with Haitian vetiver, sandalwood and Ambermax®. The fragrance’s distinctive character is also reflected in the bottle’s design: a black teddy bear that serves as an ironic statement, emphasising the dynamic side of the creation. Fragrance family: Spicy-woody with floral and fruity accents Top note: A lively opening with Italian bergamot, pear and pink pepper Heart note: Floral notes of magnolia and rose meet spicy clove Base note: A warm, long-lasting base of vetiver, sandalwood and Ambermax® Character: Distinctive, dynamic and playful

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy 2 Pearl Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Presented in a playful teddy bear-shaped bottle, whose surface shimmers with a mesmerising mother-of-pearl effect, Moschino Toy 2 Pearl is a modern unisex fragrance from 2023. The composition opens with an invigorating top note of zesty lemon and lemon sorbet, accompanied by a subtle hint of oregano. As the fragrance develops, a heart of floral notes—jasmine and freesia—unfolds, combined with a unique sandy accord that evokes a warm sea breeze. The base is formed by earthy and woody notes of vetiver and cypress, harmoniously rounded off by soft musk. The result is a multi-faceted fragrance that combines fresh, aquatic and floral elements with a subtle warmth. Its elegant yet vibrant character makes it a truly special fragrance experience. A fresh, citrusy-aquatic unisex fragrance. A composition of lemon, jasmine, sand and vetiver. Presented in the iconic teddy bear bottle with a mother-of-pearl finish. Combines floral notes with a warm, woody base.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Fresh Couture Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: With a design that deliberately plays on the aesthetics of everyday objects, Fresh Couture Eau de Toilette comes in the form of a conventional spray bottle for cleaning products. Behind this humorous and ironic façade, with its transparent blue contents, lies a carefully crafted fragrance composition from the floral-woody family. Launched in 2015, the fragrance opens with a fresh top note, in which accords of bergamot and mandarin blend with the exotic notes of ylang-ylang. As the fragrance develops, a fruity yet floral heart comes to the fore, combining sweet hints of raspberry with the elegance of white peony and osmanthus. This perfume, manufactured in Italy, is sensually rounded off by a base note of light woods, white patchouli and ambroxan. This combination lends the fragrance a modern character that emphasises the deliberate contrast between the unassuming bottle and the high-quality contents. listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy Boy Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Moschino Toy Boy Eau de Parfum Spray is a fragrance that plays with a touch of irony and has been created for a dynamic and passionate personality. This woody-spicy composition opens with a multifaceted top note, in which the freshness of Italian bergamot and green pear meets the piquant spice of pink berries and Indonesian nutmeg. Elemi buds and cloves add a further layer of complexity. At the heart of the fragrance, an elegant bouquet of Neoabsolut Orpur Rose, delicate flax blossoms and magnolia unfolds, given a special depth by the soft, woody warmth of cashmere wood. The base note anchors the composition with earthy Haitian vetiver and the modern, warm accents of Ambermax and Sylkolide, which ensure a memorable finish. The bottle itself is an unmistakable design statement, featuring Moschino’s iconic teddy bear motif in elegant black. Fragrance family: Woody-spicy Top note: A composition of bergamot, pink berries and nutmeg. Heart note: Floral accents of rose and magnolia meet cashmere wood. Design: Distinctive bottle in the iconic teddy bear look.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Forever Sailing Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Forever Sailing Eau de Toilette Spray by Moschino manifests on the skin as a pleasantly fresh scent and is therefore the perfect perfume for spring and summer. A creation with maritime accents and a sophisticated finish of sensual woody notes. The perfume begins with a splash and refreshes with a clear, soul stimulating note of mint. Lemon primofiore and juicy grapefruit ensure a tingling breeze . Thus the Forever Sailing Eau de Toilette Spray by Moschino conveys a pleasant feeling of airy freedom to the wearer. A feeling like a beach day by the sea where you can see as far as the horizon. The necessary grounding is achieved by lavender and juniper. The fragrance collection is based on Sex Appeal and love of life. Whether stylish, sensual or sexy, this perfume is there to give that moment of insouciance, a moment of pure enjoyment , which luxury along can give, to enjoy life to the fullest. The Eau de Toilette Spray Forever Sailing is by the brand founded in the Italian fashion market in 1983. Clothing, accessories and fragrances symbolise the typical Moschino style, which is at once fresh and unconventional, as well as exceptionally luxurious.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Explorer Eau de Parfum Spray by Montblanc is a warm woody fragrance for men that is refined with spirited aromatic spices. With elegant Akigalawood and spirited pepper The Explorer Eau de Parfum Spray by Montblanc is a charismatic men's fragrance with an elegant oriental undertone and energising spices. The creation initially refreshes you when you spray it on with an invigorating blend of bergamot, hot pink pepper and clary sage. The heart note is characterised by a masculine leather nuance , which is complemented by earthy Haitian vetiver grass. The base is given an exotic flair by Indonesian patchouli leaves. The warm scent of Akigalawood, gentle ambroxan and cocoa fruits add a mild, subliminal sweetness to the bouquet. When you hear the name "Montblanc", you first think of stylish writing instruments and elegant leather goods, but the company, which originally came from Germany, has also launched more than 25 perfumes on the market since 2001. Like all of its products, the fragrances also exude a classic elegance - the Explorer Eau de Parfum Spray, available since 2019 and created in collaboration with master perfumers Olivier Pescheux and Antoine Maisondieu, is no exception.

listings.description: Explorer Extreme from Montblanc comes in an impressive, deep black flacon. What kind of mysterious perfume might be hidden inside? listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Legend Elixir Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: The Montblanc Legend Elixir perfume is a highly concentrated amber-fougère fragrance with a long-lasting presence throughout the day. Immediately after spraying, a fresh combination of bergamot, lavender and pink pepper opens the fragrance experience and offers an invigorating start to the morning. As the fragrance progresses, the heart notes of floral iris and fruity pomarose™ reveal a profound facet that emphasises a self-confident charisma in everyday life. Finally, warm base notes such as vanilla, amber woods and incense resin round off the composition and leave a striking, memorable aura that is particularly suitable for evening occasions or important dates. listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Legend Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: With the fresh, woody Eau de Parfum Spray Legend, the Hamburg-based luxury label Montblanc is continuing its line of 'legendary' men's fragrances, which have long since achieved cult status. Launched in 2020, the fragrance is, like its predecessors, a creation by star perfumer Olivier Pescheux . Following the fresh fougère composition from 2011, the casually elegant Spirit version presented in 2016 and the seductively sensual Night version presented in 2018, a creation with an emphatically intense signature and sensual, charming orientation is now being presented. This gives the Eau de Parfum Spray Legend by Montblanc impressive longevity and particularly good sillage. An exclusive, successful perfume with innovative charm The new version of Montblanc Legend also captivates with the familiar and successful accord with notes of beguilingly fragrant jasmine and soft, green moss, underlaid with sweet and tart nuances of bergamot. However, the Eau de Parfum Spray from 2020 expands the exquisite fragrance sequence with green, aromatic facets of dewy violet leaves and seductively graceful magnolia. Strong accents of resinous wood and fresh, soft leather add irresistibly elegant nuances to the composition. Lovers of the original perfume will also find the original notes in this excitingly modern fragrance and yet be delighted by the deep radiance of the characterful new creation.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Platinum Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Anyone who first thinks of high-quality writing instruments when they hear the name Montblanc is not entirely wrong: in fact, the Explorer Platinum men's fragrance also comes from the portfolio of the famous Swiss luxury brand. Perfume lovers have known Montblanc for more than two decades. In 2001, a separate perfume range, "Presence", was added to the already well-developed brand portfolio of luxury accessories such as briefcases, jewellery and wristwatches. The Explorer perfume range was launched in 2019 with the perfume of the same name, which quickly became very popular . With Explorer Platinum Eau de Parfum Spray, Montblanc has launched a fragrance that bridges the gap between spicy and sweet woody notes - a perfume that is appreciated for its distinctive originality. With a top note of violet leaf and a heart note of aromatic-balsamic clary sage, the men's fragrance gains sweetness and freshness. The eau de parfum spray is rounded off with a base note of cedar wood, which carries and summarises the composition with its dark depth. Explorer Platinum Eau de Parfum Spray was created by three well-known perfume artists: the highly experienced Fabrice Pellegrin, who has already worked for a number of major perfume houses from Dior to Gaultier, Bruno Jovanovicz (e.g. Armani, Lagerfeld) and Nathalie Lorsson, whose list of previous activities also reads like a Who's Who of famous perfume brands. The perfume is supplied in a high-quality silver bottle in the typical Explorer look.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The composition of Lacoste Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray is characterised by a sophisticated balance of floral, woody and musky elements that embody a modern yet timeless aesthetic. The olfactory experience opens with a top note full of character, combining the fruity freshness of green apple and bergamot with the subtle spiciness of black pepper, purple freesia and nutmeg oil. As the fragrance progresses, a multi-layered heart unfolds, combining classic floral accords of white jasmine, rose and violet with the delicate nuances of hibiscus and heliotrope to create a harmonious bouquet. The complex base note, which combines the woody depth of sandalwood and cedarwood with incense, labdanum and a velvety suede accord and musk, ensures a long-lasting and warm finish. The design of the bottle picks up on this clear line visually: A slender, rectangular glass body with rounded corners and pale yellow contents is topped by a cylindrical cap with a textured, gold-coloured surface. On the front, the characteristic gold-coloured crocodile logo is emblazoned on a vertical label, discreetly underlining the affiliation with the brand. Created by Olivier Cresp, this fragrance stands for an understated elegance that radiates creativity and a sense of style. Fragrance family: Floral-woody with musky nuances Top notes: Combination of freesia, black pepper and green apple Base: Warm accords of sandalwood, incense and suede Design: Elegant glass bottle with gold-coloured accents and crocodile logo

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste L.12.12 Noir Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Lacoste L.12.12 Noir Eau de Toilette Spray is a men's fragrance inspired by the brand's iconic polo shirt. This aromatic-woody fougère composition opens with an invigorating top note that combines the juicy freshness of watermelon with pineapple and red berries. A hint of basil adds a spicy facet to the opening. The heart of the fragrance then unfolds, characterised by the clear notes of lavender and lemon verbena, which are complemented by Egyptian basil and create an aromatic character. The fragrance concludes with a deep base note. This is where the intense flavours of dark chocolate meet earthy patchouli, warm cashmeran and coumarin, giving the fragrance a special depth. With its classic intensity, the eau de toilette is particularly suitable for the evening or the transitional months. The simple, black bottle echoes the design of the polo shirt and features an embroidered crocodile emblem. listings.rawTitle: KENZO Kenzo Homme Eau de Parfum Spray 60 ml
listings.description: The KENZO HOMME Eau de Parfum Spray by perfumer Quentin Bisch is a woody-maritime fragrance composition. At the centre of the fragrance, a maritime accord combines with the warmth of leather and the earthy depth of patchouli to create a multi-faceted and expressive character. The bottle itself makes a clear statement: inspired by the vertical strength of bamboo, it comes in deep black with bluish nuances. The design of the cap is reminiscent of the diagonal cut of a katana. The concept also takes sustainable aspects into account. The bottle is made from 15% recycled glass and the weight of the glass has been reduced by 23% to allow for 10 ml more perfume in the 110 ml size. The cap saves 34% plastic, while the outer packaging is made from untreated kraft cardboard and FSC®-certified paper. Scent direction: woody-maritime Fragrance notes: Maritime accord, leather, patchouli Design: Bamboo-inspired bottle with a katana-cut cap Sustainability: bottle made from recycled glass and packaging from responsible sources

listings.rawTitle: KENZO L'EAU KENZO Eau de Parfum Spray Ambrée 30 ml
listings.description: The Kenzo L'Eau Ambrée Eau de Parfum captures the warm atmosphere of a sunset in a floral-amber-coloured fragrance composition. The top notes of fruity fig and a trio of ylang-ylang open the fragrance experience and accompany you through everyday life with a pleasant lightness. Ambrox®, Aquozone®, Immortelle Absolute and sandalwood unfold their flavours in the heart, giving the fragrance a special depth. This combination emphasises your charisma on evening occasions as well as in the office. A base of Tahitian vanilla and benzoin rounds off the profile and leaves a long-lasting, warm impression. Designed as a unisex fragrance, the creation adapts individually and offers a versatile application for every taste. The clear, oval glass bottle with its silver spray head elegantly presents the pale pink liquid. Floral-amber-coloured unisex fragrance for versatile everyday use. Top notes of fruity fig and ylang trio for a light opening. Heart notes of Ambrox®, Aquozone®, Immortelle Absolute and Sandalwood. Warm finish with Tahitian vanilla and benzoin in the base. Practical 100 ml size for long-lasting use.

listings.description: KENZO JUNGLE Eau de Parfum Spray is a composition by master perfumer Dominique Ropion that is characterised by an unmistakable, spicy-amber character. The fragrance opens with a lively top note of cardamom, clove and a hint of mandarin. An opulent bouquet unfolds in the heart, in which the exotic sweetness of mango meets floral notes of ylang-ylang, gardenia and heliotrope, rounded off by a fascinating nuance of liquorice and vanilla flower. The base note anchors the composition with the warm depth of vanilla, amber and earthy patchouli. This eau de parfum has a remarkable presence and longevity, making it an ideal companion for the cooler months. The bottle is adorned with a golden elephant, which symbolises a good omen and makes the design unique. listings.rawTitle: KENZO Kenzo Amour Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: KENZO AMOUR Eau de Parfum is an olfactory interpretation of a journey full of love and gentle impressions. Created by Daphné Bugey in 2006, the fragrance unfolds with delicate notes of cherry and frangipani blossom. These floral accents are then combined with the subtle aroma of white tea and rice steam, resulting in a soft and powdery composition. A warm base of vanilla, musk, incense and the characteristic Thanaka wood rounds off the fragrance experience and lends it a long-lasting depth. This woody-floral musk fragrance is particularly suitable for the cooler days of autumn and winter. The design of the fragrance was honoured with the prestigious FiFi Award for best packaging and as fragrance of the year in its category. Fragrance: Floral, woody, musky Character: Soft, powdery and sensual Fragrance notes: Cherry blossom, white tea, rice, vanilla, musk Product type: Eau de Parfum Spray

listings.rawTitle: KENZO FLOWER BY KENZO Eau de Parfum Spray Le Rouge 30 ml
listings.description: LE ROUGE FLOWER Eau de Parfum by KENZO reinterprets the iconic FLOWER signature in a powerful and sensual way. This floral-gourmand fragrance for women stands for intensity, depth and emotional radiance and is aimed at women who embody strength and elegance in equal measure. The opening is clear and pure: delicate musk meets fine rice vapour and gives the fragrance a modern, almost floating lightness. At the heart, the Damask rose unfolds in a more intense, multi-faceted form that redefines floral sensuality. The base seduces with a warm, enveloping composition of vanilla and sandalwood, enhanced by Amberever®, a powerful woody molecule that gives the fragrance depth and a long-lasting presence. As an olfactory interpretation of the colour red, LE ROUGE FLOWER combines vibrant energy with the Japanese DNA of the Maison KENZO and at the same time stands for a conscious commitment to sustainability. listings.rawTitle: KENZO FLOWER BY KENZO Eau de Parfum Spray Ikebana Sakura 40 ml
listings.description: The KENZO FLOWER BY KENZO Ikebana Eau de Parfum Spray is an olfactory homage to Kenzo Takada's love of flowers and the art of living. Inspired by the Japanese art of flower arranging, Ikebana, a floral-woody composition created by perfumers Alexandra Monet and Alberto Morillas unfolds. At the centre of the fragrance is a balance of three distinctive notes: It opens with the unique aroma of sobacha tea, followed by the delicate sakura cherry blossom, enhanced by Indian tuberose absolute. A warm base of Australian sandalwood, cedarwood and vetiver gives the fragrance a lasting depth. Made in France, the eau de parfum consists of around 90% ingredients of natural origin. The bottle, which is reminiscent of a Japanese kakemono, emphasises the brand's conscious approach through the use of recycled materials and a recyclable cap. A floral-woody fragrance inspired by the Japanese art of ikebana. Main notes of sobacha tea, sakura cherry blossom and Australian sandalwood. Consists of around 90% ingredients of natural origin. Environmentally conscious bottle with recyclable glass cap.

listings.rawTitle: KENZO Kenzo Homme Eau de Parfum Spray Indigo 60 ml
listings.description: The KENZO HOMME Indigo Eau de Parfum Spray is a men's fragrance composition inspired by the power of nature. It opens with fresh, marine accords reminiscent of the clear coastal air. A creamy, woody iris extract with musky facets unfolds at the heart of the fragrance. The base note anchors the composition with a warm leather accord, which is characterised by smoky nuances and the depth of Akigala wood, sandalwood and vetiver. Kenzo pursues a sustainable approach with this perfume, which is reflected in the formula with around 95% ingredients of natural origin. The alcohol used comes from French farms that are switching to regenerative agriculture. The design of the bottle picks up on this closeness to nature: The opaque, indigo blue lacquer with a matt texture is reminiscent of a bamboo cane, while the bevelled cap is inspired by the shape of a katana samurai sword. listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Eau de Toilette Spray Mirto di Panarea 50 ml
listings.description: Panarea: The smallest and oldest Aeolian island radiates peace and tranquillity. Fragmented bays, bordered by luminous olive groves, are lapped by emerald-green waters. The myrtle plant grows among wild pistachios, agaves and broom. Even the goddess Venus wanted to adorn herself with a myrtle wreath when she was chosen by Paride. Myrtle has always symbolised beauty and love, and in the Middle Ages its fragrance was known as "angel's water". The fragrance of Mirto di Panarea caresses the skin and soul with a pleasant, intensely regenerating breeze from the Italian Mediterranean. The unmistakable scent of myrtle spreads slowly and pleasantly. The fragrance opens with an elegant, sparkling top note, characterised by citrus accents such as Calabrian lemon and sweet orange. It is emphasised by the simple and unadulterated aroma of basil. The heart note unfolds a blossoming core of velvet and elegance, where accents of jasmine, rose and lilac meet a light sea breeze and traces of blackcurrant. A feeling of deep well-being that reaches its full perfection in the woody base note with the aromatic scents of wild pistachio and juniper as well as cedarwood and amber.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Oud & Spice 50 ml
listings.description: The Oud & Spice Eau de Parfum Spray from the Signatures Of The Sun fragrance line by Acqua di Parma combines exquisite spices with warm woody and appealing oriental fragrance accords. With spirited pepper and elegant agarwood The Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Oud & Spice Eau de Parfum Spray is a self-confident fragrance for men, based on a slightly tart base, which is livened up by sparkling fruity nuances in the top note. An exquisite blend of spices rounds off the fragrance, which has been available since 2021, and gives it temperament. Upon application, Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Oud & Spice Eau de Parfum Spray initially envelops you in an invigorating blend of tangy bergamot and seductive raspberries, which combine with an elegant rose nuance. The heart note consists of pink pepper , cloves and cinnamon and gives the creation strength and an excitingly passionate tone. The base has a gentle and calming effect: warm agarwood meets creamy ladan resin and oriental patchouli, which has a pleasantly rough and masculine effect.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Sandalo 50 ml
listings.description: Sandalo is a fresh and woody eau de parfum spray from the exclusive Milanese boutique Acqua di Parma. Launched in 2016, the unisex fragrance is characterised by a harmonious composition full of elegance and freshness . Very precious and rare sandalwood from India, which is characterised by the particular richness and intensity of its aromas, is the olfactory theme of this perfume. The citrus notes typical of the Colonia creation create a fascinating arc of tension. Timeless elegance in a trendy style Acqua di Parma Sandalo opens sparklingly fresh with a wide range of citrusy notes. The multi-faceted fragrance of petit grain, the oil from the leaves of the bitter orange, is joined by sparkling notes of subtly tart bergamot, ripe lemon and juicy orange. In the heart note, Acqua di Parma Sandalo Eau de Parfum Spray presents an irresistible play of colours and aromas. The intense, unmistakable scent of lavender from Provence is given additional character and depth by spicy, creamy accents of cardamom. In the base of the fragrance, the precious sandalwood impressively brings its elegance to the fore. Delicious, opulent tonka bean and soft ambergris bring this enchanting eau de parfum spray to an impressive close with a hint of irresistible sensuality. A unisex perfume that fascinates with its sophisticated composition and the intensity of its notes.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Oud 50 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Oud is a new fragrance from Acqua di Parma. Launched in 2019, the Eau de Parfum Spray is a variation of Colonia Oud, which has been available since 2012 and is an Eau de Cologne Concentrée. Of course, both woody-spicy fragrances are men's fragrances, but some women also like to wear them. The eau de parfum spray from Acqua di Parma is naturally significantly stronger in its presence and has enormous longevity and sillage, just as you would expect from an eau de parfum spray from the traditional Milanese brand. A fragrance that definitely stands out The top note of Acqua di Parma perfume begins with Italian orange and Calabrian bergamot. It gives way to heart notes of Russian coriander, Haitian amyris and, of course, precious oud. In the almost opulent base, the flavours of Atlas cedar meet Indonesian patchouli, fine sandalwood and musk. The result is a noble masculine composition that is particularly suitable for wearing on cooler days, but can also be worn on summer evenings. Acqua di Parma Oud is a fragrance that flatters the modern man of today. This is because the fragrance has a clear but not overpowering presence.

The result is a noble masculine composition that is particularly suitable for wearing on cooler days, but can also be worn on summer evenings. Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Quercia 50 ml
listings.description: The Colonia Quercia fragrance dates back to 2016 and was released as an eau de parfum spray by Acqua di Parma in 2019. The fragrance of the masculine eau de parfum spray is spicy and woody . It is debatable whether the perfume is more of a unisex fragrance or a men's fragrance. However, you won't argue about the elegant composition, the chic black bottle or the enormous longevity and sillage. Querica by Acqua di Parma is not an eau de parfum spray for everyone. The fragrance is aimed at people who are looking for the extraordinary , but don't want to find it in screamingly loud compositions. They are not looking for a fragrance with rough edges, but something expressive. Intensity sends its regards The top note of Acqua di Parma Quercia consists of pink pepper, petitgrain, lemon and bergamot. The heart note combines rose geranium, cardamom and cedarwood. Patchouli, tonka bean absolute and oakmoss absolute round off the eau de parfum. Acqua di Parma Quercia is suitable for everyday wear, but can also be worn in the evening. The eau de parfum spray has the all-round qualities typical of the Milanese label, which is aimed at the modern man of today, who feels just as comfortable in jeans as in a suit.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Osmanthus 50 ml
listings.description: Acqua di Parma Osmanthus is a floral-fruity unisex perfume from 2019. The eau de parfum spray is a wonderful addition to the 'Signature of the Sun' fragrance line, which presents particularly precious olfactory ingredients against a radiant, sun-drenched backdrop. Acqua di Parma Osmanthus invites you to take an unforgettable walk through the green forest landscape of south-east Asia . This is the home of the shrub from whose flowers the irresistibly fruity-scented absolute that gives the eau de parfum spray its name is extracted. Its delicate, delicious peach aromas carry subtle nuances of wood and leather and ensure elegant sensuality. An elegant floral fragrance with a sparkling opening Acqua di Parma Osmanthus opens sparkling and fresh with juicy, green mandarin from Sicily and fragrant neroli oil, which powerfully reveals its citrusy richness. The top note brings subtly sensual accents into play. The floral fragrance of delicate peony is joined by beguiling ambrette with its soft, creamy musky scent. A hint of pink pepper discreetly limits the intense notes and gives the eau de parfum spray a fascinating tingle. In the base of the perfume, the star of the show, the osmanthus fragrance, unfolds all its magic. Mossy, woody patchouli supports its sensual elegance with mossy, woody accents.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Yuzu 50 ml
listings.description: The citrus-aromatic Eau de Parfum Spray Yuzu is the latest member of the 'Frutti d'Oro' family from the traditional luxury perfume house Acqua di Parma. Launched in 2019, the unisex fragrance by French star perfumers Nicolas Bonneville and François Demachy is dedicated to Japan's most delicious fruit , the yuzu. Its unique, bitter-sweet aroma combines with the citrusy accents so typical of Acqua di Parma fragrances to create a tingling, fresh fragrance experience with an addictive character. A sparkling fragrance with plenty of elegance and a touch of sensuality The Eau de Parfum Spray opens with a revitalising cocktail in which an intense yuzu accent is joined by the aromas of juicy bergamot from Calabria and sparkling Szechuan pepper. Delicate, graceful blossoms unfold their magic in the heart of the perfume. It presents an elegant, white bouquet of noble lotus, delicate mimosa and fragrant jasmine, gently framed by a green nuance of violet leaf. The extraordinary base of the Eau de Parfum Spray from Acqua di Parma is decidedly sensual. Soft, warm musk, precious sandalwood and liquorice and a hint of liquorice bring the fragrance to an impressive close.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Magnolia Infinita 100 ml
listings.description: Italian sophistication and discreet luxury: this is what Acqua di Parma has stood for since it was founded in 1916. Created by Baron Carlo Magnani from Parma for personal fragrances, Acqua di Parma has maintained its reputation as a centre of elegant fragrances to this day. The Signatures Of The Sun series with the composition Magnolia Infinita Eau de Parfum Spray is a testament to the craftsmanship of Italian perfumery. The creation for women combines the radiant scent of magnolia with the vibrancy of fresh citrus notes. Released in 2022, Magnolia Infinita Eau de Parfum Spray is still a relatively new addition to the Acqua di Parma fragrances. Elegant and floral fragrance cocktail in an iconic bottle The Magnolia Infinita Eau de Parfum Spray from the Signatures Of The Sun series combines the scent of Calabrian bergamot and the fresh aroma of orange and lemon in the top note. A few moments later, the intense and lush heart note surprises with a combination of magnolia, jasmine, rose and ylang-ylang. The sensual notes of musk and patchouli meet in the base. The transparent black bottle of Magnolia Infinita Eau de Parfum Spray is iconic. It is adorned with the black Signatures of the Sun label. With its golden lettering, it interprets the vibrant rays of the sun.
