listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Luce di Rosa Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: If you are looking for an exclusive and exquisite perfume, we recommend the eau de parfum spray Luce di Rosa from the Acqua di Parma label. This fragrance is characterised by both modernity and dynamism and pampers the olfactory senses in a unique way thanks to its composition of floral, woody and rosy notes. A perfume that knows how to refresh Luce di Rosa owes its incomparably fresh fragrance to a sophisticated fragrance pyramid. The top notes are bergamot, longoza oil and pink pepper , while the heart notes are rose oil, geranium and fresh black pepper . Finally, the base note is composed of vetiver oil, guaiac wood and cedar wood . It is therefore not surprising that this eau-de-perfume spray casts a very special spell over its wearer and their surroundings. Acqua di Parma is a unisex fragrance, making it suitable for couples who want to show that they belong together. It is no coincidence that this perfume is so captivating, as the Acqua di Parma company has existed since 1916 and can therefore look back on a long tradition. This eau-de-parfum spray, which is typical of the Italian art of living, is the result of a wealth of experience.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia Eau de Parfum Spray Colonia Il Profumo 50 ml
listings.description: Experience the quintessence of Italian perfumery with Acqua di Parma's Colonia Il Profumo Eau de Parfum Spray. This exclusive perfume is a timeless unisex fragrance that captures the Mediterranean lifestyle in its purest form. The sparkling top note opens with a fascinating interplay of sun-ripened bergamot, juicy blood orange and refreshing grapefruit, refined by the elegant spice of petitgrain. This citrus symphony blends harmoniously into a floral, aromatic heart, where delicate orange blossom combines with tart rosemary and exotic ylang-ylang to create a seductive composition. Sensual unisex fragrance by Acqua di Parma for special occasions The full strength of character of the fragrance unfolds in the base note through the combination of earthy patchouli and woody vetiver, which give the perfume its unmistakable depth and persistence. Colonia Il Profumo is an aromatic-citrusy eau de parfum spray that is perfect for people who are looking for something special. The classic flacon design with the characteristic yellow label emphasises the timeless elegance of this extraordinary creation. A fragrance that skilfully blurs the boundaries between masculine and feminine, creating an exclusive aura that delights from morning to night. The perfect choice for individualists who value Italian craftsmanship and authentic luxury products.</p

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Eau de Toilette Spray 40 ml
listings.description: Davidoff Cool Water Eau de Toilette Spray is an iconic fragrance that evokes the untamed power and freshness of the ocean. Since its launch in 1988, this fragrance has been regarded as a timeless classic. It opens with an intense, aromatic wave in which marine notes blend with fresh mint, coriander and lavender. As the fragrance develops, the composition transitions into a heart of sandalwood, jasmine and neroli, which lends the scent a clear yet subtle depth. The base note ensures a long-lasting and warm finish, with nuances of musk, ambergris and cedarwood blending harmoniously. Presented in the distinctive blue bottle, the atomiser allows for easy and precise application. The eau de toilette unfolds best when sprayed from a short distance onto warm areas of skin such as the wrists. A timeless fragrance classic with a fresh and aquatic character. listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Night Dive Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Cool Water Night Dive: Fresh in a new way Davidoff stands for quality and innovative men’s fragrances without doubt. With the perfume Cool Water Night Dive perfumer Jean-Christophe Hérault has succeeded in creating a perfume that is a cut above the rest. Hérault learnt his trade from scratch with Pierre Bourdon, who created a milestone with Cool Water in the history of perfumery a quarter of a century ago. The Eau de Toilette Spray from Davidoff that is currently conquering the market is paying homage to the great master. A clear and sensual perfume for men The new scent is green-oriental, a vital prerequisite for the mysterious aura that surrounds this otherwise cool and composed perfume. The basis of the scent is the wood of the pistachio , an extremely valuable and rarely used raw material that is also known as mastic wood. The precious Eau de Toilette Spray develops opening with a note of fresh fruit and mint that is an ideal match for the sensual woody note. A hint of cashmere adds an oriental component to the mix. The successful composition is rounded off through typically male ingredients such as amber, sage, black pepper, tobacco and musk. And yet, words alone can’t do it justice. Cool Water Night Dive from Davidoff is a clear enticement to get a sniff of it.

listings.description: The Calvin Klein Euphoria Bold Elixir offers a long-lasting fragrance experience for the whole day, which remains particularly long-lasting on the skin with its exceptionally high fragrance concentration of over 28 per cent. The composition opens with clear jasmine, which exudes an inviting freshness as soon as it is sprayed on. A smoky orchid unfolds in the heart, lending the fragrance a deep, sensual note and making it ideal for evening occasions or expressive moments in everyday life. The base is a harmonious combination of intense oak wood and vanilla roasted under the Madagascan sun. These warm accords round off the fragrance profile and leave an elegant, woody presence that skilfully underlines your own appearance. The practical pump atomiser enables precise application to pulse points such as the neck and wrists, allowing the individual aromas to unfold optimally through body heat. Visually, the Eau de Parfum Intense comes in a curved, vibrant purple bottle that exudes a modern aesthetic. Depending on personal requirements, the fragrance is available in the practical sizes 30 ml, 50 ml and 100 ml. listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK Everyone Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Calvin Klein CK Everyone Eau de Parfum Spray is a modern and multi-faceted fragrance composition that deliberately avoids gender-specific categorisation and is designed for everyone. The fragrance opens with the tangy freshness of Mexican organic orange, which forms an invigorating and juicy top note. The gentle aroma of black tea from Sri Lanka unfolds at the heart of the composition, giving the fragrance a soft and characterful depth. The warm, woody base of Haitian vetiver ensures a long-lasting and elegant finish. With its fresh, sporty and casual character, this all-rounder is ideal as an everyday companion, especially on warmer days. The vegan formula consists of 77% ingredients of natural origin. The recyclable glass bottle is complemented by the iconic Calvin Klein-style rubber band and emphasises the brand's timeless and minimalist approach. A fresh and modern unisex fragrance for everyday wear. Fragrance notes of organic Mexican orange, black tea and Haitian vetiver. Vegan formula with 77% ingredients of natural origin. Minimalist design with recyclable glass bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity for Men Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Calvin Klein Eternity for Men is a men's fragrance that has been a timeless classic since its launch in 1990. The eau de toilette is characterised by its clear, aromatic fragrance composition. It opens with a refreshing top note of mandarin, lavender and bergamot. A spicy bouquet with notes of basil, sage and juniper berries unfolds in the heart, giving the fragrance its unmistakable character. The base note rounds off the olfactory experience with warm, woody accords of sandalwood, rosewood and vetiver. This balanced blend makes Eternity for Men an aromatic fougère fragrance that is described as modern and unobtrusive. It is suitable for everyday wear as well as for special occasions. The simple, elegant bottle made of clear glass with silver accents reflects the pure character of the fragrance. A timeless, aromatic-fresh fougère fragrance. Balanced composition of citrus fruits, spicy herbs and warm woods. Modern and understated character for a variety of occasions. Presented in a simple, elegant bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK be Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Calvin Klein ck be Eau de Toilette Spray is a universal fragrance that was created for all genders. Since its introduction in 1997 by perfumer Ann Gottlieb, the composition has been captivating with its unobtrusive yet expressive character. It opens with an invigorating freshness of bergamot, mandarin and mint, rounded off by the spicy note of juniper berries. A gentle accord of white peach unfolds in the heart, which meets fine spices and lends the fragrance a subtle warmth. The base is long-lasting and multi-layered, with notes of sandalwood, musk, tonka bean and a hint of vanilla that create a sensual depth. Captured in a minimalist, black bottle, ck be is an ideal companion for every day and occasion, especially where a subtle fragrance is appreciated. A unisex fragrance from the floral-woody-musky fragrance family. Combines an invigorating top note with a warm, sensual base of wood and musk. Decent character, ideal for everyday use and the work environment. Presented in an iconic, sleek black bottle.

listings.description: The Aromatic Essence Parfum Intense Spray from Calvin Klein is a modern interpretation of the iconic Eternity line. This aromatic, fruity men's fragrance from 2024 is characterised by an extraordinary fragrance composition. It opens with an invigorating freshness of juniper berries and lemon, which is given an exciting facet by the subtle spiciness of Szechuan pepper. At the heart of the composition, an unexpected coconut accord unfolds, lending the fragrance a subtle, tropical nuance and accompanied by classic lavender notes. The result is a multi-layered and expressive fragrance with a pleasant presence and solid longevity that is a mature and interesting alternative. listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK one Parfum Intense Spray Night Essence 50 ml
listings.description: The Calvin Klein CK One Night Essence Parfum Intense enriches special moments in the evening with an intense fragrance composition. As a double-concentrated unisex perfume, this fragrance offers a long-lasting experience that is equally suitable for everyone. The top notes of cardamom, shiso and iris open the fragrance experience with a spicy-fresh nuance that immediately appeals to the senses. Patchouli, tea and suede then unfold a profound character in the heart. This combination creates an elegant atmosphere that is ideal for evenings out or special events. Finally, sandalwood, ambergris and musk form the base and leave a warm, woody finish on the skin. Thanks to the intensive formulation, just a few sprays are enough for a present but unobtrusive scent. The minimalist, dark transparent bottle blends elegantly into any environment. This fragrance adds a luxurious and modern component to your personal routine. This fragrance composition is aimed at lovers of sensual yet fresh scents. It opens with a clear top note in which aquatic nuances combine with aromatic, lavender-like accents to create an invigorating opening. A silky coconut water accord then unfolds in the heart, which is elegantly enveloped by delicate floral essences. The base note of creamy sandalwood provides a special depth and a long-lasting impression, giving the fragrance a warm and seductive finish. The perfume combines aromatic freshness with floral and gourmand elements to create a multi-faceted experience. The elegant bottle made of blue-green lacquered glass, inspired by the radiance of green gemstones, emphasises the character of the fragrance with its shape and silver cap, echoing the classic design of the Eternity family. A modern interpretation of the iconic Calvin Klein Eternity fragrance. Combines fresh, aquatic notes with a heart of coconut water. A base of creamy sandalwood gives the fragrance a sensual depth. Presented in a gemstone-inspired, blue-green bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity for Men Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Calvin Klein Eternity for Men fragrance is an intense and multi-faceted interpretation of the fougère fragrance family with gourmand accents. Inspired by the original ETERNITY fragrance, the composition opens with an aromatic blend of organic lavender and refreshing mint oil. A warm and distinctive rum extract unfolds at the heart of the fragrance creation, leading into a sensual base. This is where vanilla absolute from Madagascar and woody notes of Indonesian patchouli meet. Upcycled cedarwood oil emphasises the warm, amber-coloured character of the fragrance. The vegan formulation consists of sustainably sourced ingredients and is around 71% biodegradable. The perfume is presented in a luxurious cognac glass bottle that pays homage to the classic Eternity line. Fragrance direction: Fougère-Gourmand Fragrance notes: Lavender, rum extract, vanilla absolute, cedarwood Intensity: Intense Properties: Vegan formulation with sustainably sourced ingredients

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Obsession Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Since its launch in 1985, Calvin Klein Obsession has established itself as a distinctive fragrance. The composition is characterised by its warm and spicy notes, which create an intense and commanding aura. The fragrance opens with fresh notes of mandarin and bergamot, which blend with a hint of vanilla. At its heart, a harmonious blend of jasmine, orange blossom and a selection of spices unfolds, lending the fragrance its characteristic depth. The base notes round off the experience with accords of oakmoss, musk and amber, ensuring a long-lasting impression. The Eau de Parfum Spray is presented in an elegant, oval bottle made of transparent glass, whose warm hue reflects the character of the fragrance. Fragrance profile: Warm and spicy Top notes: Mandarin, bergamot, vanilla Heart notes: Jasmine, orange blossom, spices Base notes: oakmoss, musk, amber Concentration: Eau de Parfum

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Intense Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Eternity Intense Eau de Parfum Spray by Calvin Klein is a modern homage to the iconic original fragrance CK Eternity from 1988. The composition is inspired by the romantic atmosphere of an encounter at sunset and unfolds an intense floral-spicy character. It opens with a striking top note of Sichuan pepper, which arouses curiosity about the heart of the fragrance. A bouquet of precious Turkish rose absolute and feminine Arabian jasmine absolute unfolds there. The base note, which combines warm sandalwood with cashmeran, ensures a long-lasting and sensual depth. The vegan formula is based on the use of sustainably sourced and partially upcycled ingredients. We recommend spraying the fragrance onto warm areas of skin such as the wrists or neck for ideal fragrance development. The well-known, iconic bottle underlines the fragrance character with its feminine colouring in a delicate nude-pink. Fragrance family: floral-spicy Fragrance character: Intense and sensual Heart notes: Turkish rose absolute and Arabian jasmine absolute Special feature: Vegan formulation with sustainably sourced ingredients

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Parfum Intense Suede Essence 30 ml
listings.description: Calvin Klein Eternity for Women Suede Essence Parfum Intense is an expressive fragrance composition that enriches your personal beauty routine. The top note of lavender opens the olfactory experience and provides a pleasantly fresh accompaniment to your morning routine. This is followed by the aroma of coconut in the heart note, which lends the fragrance a gentle facet and can create a sense of familiar comfort in everyday life. The fragrance is rounded off by sandalwood in the base note, which ensures a long-lasting presence and makes the fragrance a suitable choice for a wide range of occasions, from the office to a night out. As a Parfum Intense, the product is characterised by a high fragrance concentration, which is why just a few sprays are enough to distribute the aromas evenly. This allows for straightforward, time-saving application. Visually, the fragrance is presented in a simple, beige-coloured bottle with rounded corners and a modern, metallic cap. The intense fragrance concentration allows for economical and straightforward application. The top note of lavender offers a fresh start to the day. The versatile fragrance profile is suitable for a variety of everyday situations.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity for Men Parfum Intense Suede Essence 50 ml
listings.description: With Calvin Klein Eternity For Men Suede Essence Parfum Intense, a woody, spicy fragrance can be effortlessly incorporated into your daily routine. The sand-coloured glass bottle with its silver cap blends stylishly into any bathroom décor. Immediately after spraying, a top note of juniper berry and cardamom unfolds, offering a pleasant freshness to start the day. As the fragrance develops, aromatic lavender comes to the fore, lending the scent profile a classic depth. This means the perfume can be used sparingly and reliably accompanies you through a wide variety of everyday situations. listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum Spray - refillable 30 ml
listings.description: The Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum Spray by Viktor & Rolf is a multi-layered fragrance composition that combines a wealth of floral notes with warm, deep accents. The fragrance opens with a sparkling and invigorating blend of bergamot and green tea, which creates a clear and fresh first impression. Shortly afterwards, an opulent bouquet of precious Sambac jasmine, delicate freesia, precious centifolia rose and exotic orchid unfolds at the heart of the fragrance. This floral diversity is complemented by the delicate sweetness of African orange blossom, giving the creation its unmistakable character. Earthy notes of patchouli and a hint of musk provide a long-lasting and intense base, giving the fragrance a warm and expressive dimension. This composition is bottled in a distinctive, faceted glass bottle in the shape of a garnet, whose pale pink colour elegantly reflects the contents. Its multi-layered nature makes Flowerbomb a suitable companion for everyday wear as well as for special occasions. A multi-faceted, floral fragrance with a warm base Composition of bergamot, jasmine, rose and patchouli Characteristic glass bottle in the shape of a grenade Suitable for everyday wear and special moments

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Spicebomb Eau de Toilette Spray by Viktor & Rolf is a composition based on an exciting interplay of contrasts. Created in 2012 by perfumer Olivier Polge, the fragrance unfolds with a fresh top note of bergamot and grapefruit, which is given a special vibrancy by the accents of pink pepper and elemi. At the heart of the composition, the warmth of cinnamon and saffron meets the intensity of red pepper. This spicy heart note transitions into a base of notes of vetiver, tobacco and white leather, which give the fragrance its deep and masculine character. The eau de toilette is particularly suitable for the cooler seasons and the evening. The experience is rounded off by the iconic bottle in the shape of a hand grenade, which visually emphasises the nature of the fragrance. Fragrance direction: Spicy-woody Character: Lively, powerful and masculine Fragrance notes: A composition of citrus fruits, intense spices and a base of tobacco and leather Occasion: Ideal for the cooler months and for evening occasions

listings.description: The Spicebomb Eau de Toilette Spray by Viktor & Rolf is a composition based on an exciting interplay of contrasts. Created in 2012 by perfumer Olivier Polge, the fragrance unfolds with a fresh top note of bergamot and grapefruit, which is given a special vibrancy by the accents of pink pepper and elemi. At the heart of the composition, the warmth of cinnamon and saffron meets the intensity of red pepper. This spicy heart note transitions into a base of notes of vetiver, tobacco and white leather, which give the fragrance its deep and masculine character. listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Eau de Parfum Spray Nightvision 50 ml
listings.description: The Spicebomb Nightvision Eau de Parfum Spray by Viktor & Rolf is an intense and multi-faceted fragrance composition that was launched in 2020. The fragrance opens with an exciting top note in which the freshness of grapefruit, lemon and green apple meets an ensemble of warm spices such as cardamom, clove and nutmeg. A hint of chilli provides an unexpected accent. At the heart, an aromatic depth unfolds with notes of lavender, rosemary, clary sage and coriander, which are given a special nuance by mastic resin. The base gives the fragrance its dark and long-lasting character. Here, woody and resinous accords of cedarwood, fir balsam and incense merge with the warmth of Peru balsam and patchouli to create an elegant and masculine signature. This composition differs fundamentally from the eau de toilette of the same name and is particularly recommended for the evening and the colder months of the year. An intense fragrance with an elegant, dark and mysterious character. A complex fragrance pyramid of fresh, spicy, aromatic and woody-resinous notes. The composition differs significantly from Spicebomb Nightvision Eau de Toilette. Ideal for the evening hours and the cooler months of the year.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum Spray Ruby Orchid 30 ml
listings.description: The Flowerbomb Ruby Orchid Eau de Parfum Spray by Viktor & Rolf is a composition that has been enriching the world of fragrances since 2021. The fragrance unfolds with a fruity top note of vine peach and freesia, which creates a lively opening. At the heart of the creation is a floral bouquet that combines jasmine with the eponymous ruby orchid. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a warm and sweet base note consisting of red vanilla pod and fine bourbon vanilla. This combination of floral, fruity and gourmand elements gives the perfume an intense and sensual character. For a long-lasting presence, the spray can be applied from a short distance to warm areas of skin such as the inside of the wrists or behind the ears. Flowerbomb Ruby Orchid is a fragrance for anyone who appreciates an expressive composition. Sensual, floral-fruity fragrance with gourmand notes. Composition of vine peach, ruby orchid and bourbon vanilla. An intense eau de parfum from 2021. It is particularly suitable for spring and daytime wear.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum Spray Tiger Lily 50 ml
listings.description: The Flowerbomb Tiger Lily Eau de Parfum Spray by Viktor & Rolf, released in 2023, is a floral-fruity composition for women that transports you to a sunny, exotic location. The fragrance opens with a creamy accord of coconut milk, whose gentle sweetness is balanced by the tangy freshness of bergamot. This inviting top note transitions into an opulent floral heart. The eponymous tiger lily takes centre stage here, lending the fragrance a striking, wild facet and accompanied by delicate jasmine and freesia. This bouquet creates a multi-layered floral depth. The composition finds its warm conclusion in the base note. A juicy mango accord provides a fruity sweetness that blends harmoniously with the resinous warmth of benzoin. The overall result is a sunny and warm fragrance with an unmistakable solar character. Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity, Solar Head note: coconut milk, bergamot Heart note: tiger lily, jasmine, freesia Base note: mango, benzoin Fragrance character: Warm, sunny, exotic

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Nuit Eau de Parfum Spray 10 ml
listings.description: The Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Nuit Eau de Parfum Spray turns day into night - in a charming, sensual way! Experience precious moments with the perfume that emphasises your femininity and brings out your mysterious side. Bronze Goddess Nuit is your reliable companion for romantic dinners under the stars as well as for a break in the middle of the day. Magical and enchanting Spicy, even slightly smoky, but still exuding pure femininity with a hint of flowers: this is how the Eau de Parfum Spray by Estée Lauder can be aptly described. The mystical side of this exquisite fragrance is omnipresent and transports you to a world full of magic. Experience marvellous sunsets or the view of the stars, even if only during a short dream journey in everyday life. The fragrance nuances of Bronze Goddess Nuit are very versatile and start with sweet bergamot and exotic ylang-ylang. A peppery accord keeps the perfume interesting and exciting. A bouquet of flowers then unfolds, accompanied by coconut, which reminds you of faraway destinations in places like the Caribbean. Enjoy your personal everyday time-out again and again - with the fragrance from Estée Lauder!

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One For Men Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: This eau de parfum, launched in 2015, is a deeper and denser interpretation of the classic fragrance concept. Designed by Olivier Polge, the composition is characterised by a higher concentration of fragrance oils, which ensures a long-lasting fragrance experience. The opening is characterised by a combination of grapefruit, coriander and basil, which conveys an aromatic yet elegant freshness. As the fragrance progresses, a spicy heart unfolds, in which striking notes of ginger and cardamom meet the subtle nuance of orange blossom. These elements finally merge into a persistent base characterised by accords of tobacco, amber and cedar wood, giving the perfume its woody character. The design of the bottle emphasises the value of the contents: A heavy, rectangular glass body reveals the brown liquid and is topped with a colour-coordinated, dark brown cap. The clear, geometric lines are only accentuated by a silver inscription on the front, which completes the overall aesthetic look. Fragrance: Warm and spicy with woody and aromatic elements Head note: A fresh blend of grapefruit, coriander and basil. Heart note: Spicy accents of ginger and cardamom as well as orange blossom. Base note: Deep accords of tobacco, amber and cedarwood. Design: Rectangular glass bottle with brown contents and dark brown cap.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The Only One Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Only One captures the essence of elegant, mesmerising femininity. This composition impresses with a modern combination of violet and coffee notes. Like the woman it represents, the fragrance is a complex interplay of contrasts. This beguiling creation draws its special charm from the unexpected mocha violet note. The violet opens up the fragrance and combines with subtle notes of bergamot to create a lively, fresh and juicy bouquet. A harmonious whole emerges in the heart note with the fusion of seductive notes of rich coffee and charming iris, while the base delicately envelops the senses with a coating of vanilla and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue pour homme Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Parfum Spray offers an intense fragrance composition that transports you to the vast hilly landscapes of Tuscany. The creation is presented in a clear glass bottle with a light blue lid and subtle gold-coloured accents. The fine atomiser allows you to apply the perfume precisely and evenly to the desired areas of skin. Immediately after application, a fresh note of Sicilian lemon unfolds, providing a pleasant start to the day in the morning. This balanced combination gives you an aura of presence that is suitable for both business and leisure. As this is a highly concentrated eau de parfum, you benefit from a long-lasting fragrance that will reliably accompany you for many hours and makes constant refreshing unnecessary. listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Spray 20 ml
listings.description: Devotion by Dolce&Gabbana is an eau de parfum spray that captures the essence of true devotion and passion. This beguiling eau de parfum spray opens with a vibrant explosion of citrus notes that immediately awaken the senses and exude an aura of energy and freshness. The top note consists of a carefully selected blend of sparkling bergamot, juicy citrus fruits, which together create an irresistibly attractive and invigorating opening. Exclusive perfume from Dolce&Gabbana At the heart of the fragrance, a floral bouquet of delicate orange blossom unfolds, creating a romantic and sensual atmosphere. These floral notes are skilfully interwoven with a hint of spicy patchouli, giving the perfume added depth and complexity. The base notes of Devotion perfume are warm and seductive, with rich accords of vanilla that give the fragrance an earthy, soothing quality and leave a lasting impression. These balsamic notes round off the fragrance and create a feeling of luxury and sophistication. Devotion Eau de Parfum Spray by Dolce & Gabbana is a fragrance for the confident woman who embraces her sensuality and does not shy away from expressing her passions. It is a fragrance that is suitable for both day and evening, enveloping the wearer in an aura of elegance and grace.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana L'Impératrice Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Dolce&Gabbana L'Impératrice Eau de Toilette Spray is an exclusive and extraordinary fragrance that is noble, graceful and luxurious . The name translates as "The Empress". There is therefore no doubt that this is an extravagant perfume that envelops women in a distinguished, aristocratic aura . Fruity-sweet notes meet fresh and floral influences and give every woman a romantic, seductive and extremely attractive aura. A touch of decadence is used here as a playful stylistic device. Modern, decadent and elegant - a fragrance with an aristocratic signature Fruity notes of redcurrant, kiwi and rhubarb open the unmistakable fragrance composition in the top note. The heart note is perfectly complemented by the sounds of pink cyclamen and watermelon. The Dolce&Gabbana L'Impératrice Eau de Toilette Spray is rounded off in the base with accords of grapefruit wood, musk and sandalwood. This is where the fragrance gains its depth and intensity. The perfume was launched back in 2009 and released in a new edition in 2020. Due to its lightness , L'Impératrice Eau de Toilette Spray by Dolce&Gabbana is particularly effective in the warmer seasons.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: K by Dolce&Gabbana A new era of masculinity . In an instant, the warm, cosy embrace of K by Dolce & Gabbana evokes the Italian countryside and the Mediterranean midday sun, evoking the fresh, earthy scent of the wooded Tuscan hills. The fragrance invigorates the senses with an intense combination of the citrus freshness of blood orange and Sicilian lime, amber accents of clary sage, sparkling geranium and energising lavender, a fresh hint of juniper berry and a spark of fiery allspice essence. Then a sensual cedarwood note emerges, merging with earthy vetiver before giving way to the sweet spice of patchouli to enhance the intrinsic charisma of the modern king that wears K by Dolce&Gabbana .

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The Only One Eau de Parfum Spray Intense 50 ml
listings.description: Unrivalled, unique and unmistakable - with Dolce&Gabbana The Only One Eau de Parfum Spray Intense, the name says it all. With its floral-radiant orientation , this fragrance is as playful and invigorating as it is seductive and sensual. This perfume envelops its wearer in an almost magical aura . Nuances come together here that inspire the senses and stimulate the imagination . The Only One Eau de Parfum Spray Intense by Dolce&Gabbana is a tribute to femininity and focuses on the special qualities of women. Femininity is celebrated - noble, seductive and life-affirming Notes of mandarin and neroli unfold in the top note. Jasmine and orange blossom follow in the heart note and emphasise the floral-fruity effect of the perfume. The base note exudes an aroma of vanilla and cashmere wood. The solid glass bottle in deep, shiny black already gives a visual hint that The Only One Eau de Parfum Spray Intense by Dolce&Gabbana is a fragrance of simple, stylish and unique elegance - a sweet and lovely fragrance experience that can be worn during the day as well as in the evening and during leisure time. This fragrance definitely leaves a pleasant, lasting impression.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum Intense 30 ml
listings.description: The One Eau de Parfum Intense is a fascinating reinterpretation of the well-known classic. Perfumer Quentin Bisch is responsible for this composition, which combines tried-and-tested elements with new accents. Bright notes of spicy pink pepper meet the freshness of mandarin and the fruitiness of blackcurrant in the opening. At the centre of the creation is a striking jasmine note that gives the fragrance a distinct floral character. This heart note transitions gently into a persistent base. Here, creamy vanilla and rich amber accords come together to create a harmonious finish. This combination creates an aura of opulence and warmth that remains perceptible for several hours. The high-quality content is also reflected visually. A heavy, rectangular bottle made of amber-coloured glass with clear, rounded edges houses the golden liquid. A wide, shiny metallic cap in a gold tone rounds off the design harmoniously. Black letters on the front provide a clear contrast to the warm colour of the glass and underline the modern elegance of the presentation. The eau de parfum is available in different quantities, such as 50 ml or 100 ml, to suit different needs. Intense reinterpretation of the classic fragrance by Quentin Bisch Composition of pink pepper, jasmine, vanilla and amber Rectangular amber-coloured glass bottle with gold accents Available in different sizes such as 50 ml and 100 ml

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in a world of passion and elegance with the Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Spray. This intensified version of the popular Devotion fragrance is a tribute to the timeless beauty and power of love. With its unique fragrance composition, this perfume takes you on a sensual journey. Intense perfume for intense moments The fragrance profile opens with an aromatic top note of hazelnut, which immediately captivates your senses. The floral elegance of orange blossom unfolds at the heart of the perfume, lending the fragrance a delicate, feminine note. The base note rounds off the composition with warm, sweet vanilla, which ensures a long-lasting, seductive fragrance. The Eau de Parfum Intense Spray by Dolce&Gabbana is characterised by its particularly concentrated formulation, which ensures a long-lasting fragrance. The elegant bottle with its characteristic golden cap is not only a container for the precious fragrance, but also a real piece of jewellery for your dressing table. To optimise the fragrance, it is recommended to apply the perfume to pulse points such as the wrists, neck and décolleté. It is particularly suitable for special occasions and evening events, but also gives you an aura of luxury and sophistication in everyday life. Let yourself be enchanted by the unique combination of nutty, floral and sweet notes. Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Spray is more than just a perfume - it is an expression of devotion and elegance that accompanies you throughout the day and emphasises your individual personality.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: With K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum , Dolce&Gabbana Beauty offers a fragrance for men that is as unique as it is sensual . Intense, attractive and sensual at the same time, K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum tells the story of an authentic and modern man. Right from the start, the perfume creates a sparkling opening with the fusion of fresh citrus fruits, tangy blood orange and fine essences of lemon torchio. The fragrance is intensified by a spicy note of cardamom and a hint of pimento essence. A combination of fresh geranium, soothing clary sage and exquisite lavender, refined by the addition of creamy fig milk, brings a hint of delicate sweetness to the heart of this delicate yet powerful fragrance. Finally, a sensual hint of wood, patchouli and vetiver is sprinkled through a warm Nagarmotha wood. K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum is a woody and spicy fragrance that offers an intimate glimpse into the heart of a modern king.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Men Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The Devotion Men fragrance by Dolce&Gabbana is a composition that speaks of instinct and passion. This woody-spicy fragrance opens with the invigorating freshness of Italian lemon in the top note. A multi-layered bouquet of spicy and woody accents unfolds in the heart, which is given special depth by a striking coffee note. The base is carried by patchouli, which gives the perfume a warm and sensual foundation and elegantly rounds off the fragrance character. The interplay of these notes creates a striking yet sophisticated fragrance. The design of the bottle emphasises the value of the creation. The light gold-coloured glass echoes the silhouette of the feminine Devotion fragrance and creates a visual connection. The iconic "Sacred Heart" is emblazoned on the front in a silver finish that matches the colour of the cap. The exact composition of the ingredients, which include alcohol denat, perfume and limonene, can be found in the list on the product packaging.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana K by Dolce&Gabbana Perfume 50 ml
listings.description: K by Dolce&Gabbana - a fascinating fragrance composition that embodies masculine elegance in its purest form. In this expressive eau de parfum by Dolce&Gabbana, Mediterranean freshness, aromatic spice and precious woods merge into an irresistible symbiosis. Exclusive perfume by Dolce&Gabbana for the modern man The elegant flacon presents itself like a precious treasure, its striking, handcrafted crown guarding a royal composition. Underneath, the sun-drenched sweetness of Italian blood orange first unfolds, immediately transporting the wearer to a Mediterranean garden and enchanting them with its invigorating freshness. While the citrusy notes of K by Dolce&Gabbana gently fade away, a perfectly balanced liaison of herbaceous, fresh sage and floral, spicy geranium develops at the heart of the fragrance. This aromatic combination creates a sophisticated masculinity that is both powerful and elegant in equal measure. In the depths of the composition, noble cedar and exotic nagarmotha come together in an impressive interplay. This precious root, also known as cypriol, enhances the woody-spicy character of the fragrance and ensures a long-lasting, unforgettable fragrance experience on the skin. K by Dolce&Gabbana thus embodies the perfect choice for the modern gentleman who values timeless elegance and a presence full of character - a seductive fragrance from Dolce&Gabbana that celebrates Italian perfumery craftsmanship at its finest.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Dolce Eau de Parfum Spray Shine 50 ml
listings.description: A sparkling highlight for your grand entrance: this is the Dolce Eau de Parfum Spray Shine from Dolce&Gabbana. A sunny, radiant jewel in perfume form awaits you, both visually and in terms of fragrance. Look forward to a fragrance that is both fruity and floral and will put you in the mood for the beautiful moments of spring! As beautiful as the sun ... and a similar eye-catcher is the Dolce Eau de Parfum Spray Shine with its shiny yellow-gold bottle. As is typical for Dolce&Gabbana, the fragrance is concealed in elegant packaging decorated with a bow. Even at first glance, it recalls the kiss of the sun as it peeks out from between the trees or helps a colourful meadow of flowers to take on its colourful splendour. The composition itself also evokes such a scenario: The fruity mango and grapefruit enchant in the top notes, accompanied by the equally cheerful and fresh quince. Welcomed by such a sparkling fragrance, you will certainly not find your daily tasks difficult. In the heart note, the soft floral accords of jasmine and orange blossom envelop you, wonderfully accentuated by salty notes reminiscent of a holiday. Light woods, musk and sandalwood round off the perfume in a warm and feminine way.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum Spray Intense 50 ml
listings.description: 2024 sees the launch of the Eau de Parfum Spray Intense K by Dolce&Gabbana. The perfume from Dolce&Gabbana is for men and has a fresh, oriental fragrance . Created by the grand mistress Nathalie Lorson and Daphné Bugey, this perfume only needs three ingredients to develop its casual elegance. Without a fragrance pyramid, the Eau de Parfum Spray Intense K by Dolce&Gabbana blends figs, leather and saffron. Dolce&Gabbana has succeeded in creating an expressive, sensual fragrance for men that is both elegant and casual, perceptible but not overpowering. A true all-rounder with depth Masculine fragrances are often over-present and, especially at work, men prefer to wear a fragrance that doesn't arrive 5 minutes before they do. The Eau de Parfum Spray Intense K by Dolce&Gabbana is just such a fragrance. It accompanies its wearer with a perceptible presence, but without imposing itself. Dolce&Gabbana's perfume is just as perfect for leisure as it is for work, regardless of the season. The stylish, dark blue bottle with a silver crown conceals a perfume that men like to wear and women like to notice on their counterparts. The more intense version of K from 2020 is simply ravishing .

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Dolce Eau de Toilette Spray Lily 75 ml
listings.description: Dolce Lily celebrates the charisma of the pink lily - a symbol of femininity and tenderness since time immemorial. The fragrance is a fresh, fruity, floral composition in which the delicate floral notes of the lily meet exotic passion fruit on a bed of soft, sensual musk. Powerful fruity notes open the composition - the sparkling citrus notes of Italian bergamot play with a touch of tropical passion fruit. This exotic touch leads into the floral heart note, in which sparkling pink lily blends with sophisticated rose tones. The radiance of these flowers contrasts with the soft musky notes that form a subtly sensual accord beneath and behind them. Sandalwood grounds the composition with its own depth, and vanilla tones allow the composition to linger long on the skin. The bottle picks up on the feminine elegance of the original Dolce silhouette, but now dresses in a bold pink, from which the vivacious personality of the Dolce girl shines out into the world. The familiar floral cap comes in the same vibrant pink and anticipates the fresh lily accord of the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Q by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum Spray Intense 30 ml
listings.description: Dolce&Gabbana awakens the queen in you ! With Q by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum Spray Intense, you can emphasise your feminine and self-confident style. Give your everyday life a royal touch: the perfume combines heliotrope with citrus fruits, sweet fruits and individual flowers as well as a charming base of woods and amber. Who could resist this potpourri? Discover your royal charm with Dolce&Gabbana Experience the diversity of Q by Dolce&Gabbana! The Eau de Parfum Spray Intense is as individual as your look. It starts with a revelation of cherry and citrus fruits, then moves into a heart of heliotrope and cherry and garnishes the whole thing with a hint of jasmine. It is mysterious and almost unapproachable, but the sweetness makes it playful again. In the base, accords such as amber and cedarwood are true classics that prove themselves time and time again. Overall, the different components create a sophisticated, expressive fragrance that skilfully interweaves tradition and modernity. Feel like a queen at every moment with Q by Dolce&Gabbana! This is achieved on the one hand by the fragrance itself and on the other by the royal flacon, which is closed with a crown.

Created by master perfumer Violaine Collas, the fragrance combines delicate rose absolute and fresh centifolia notes with soft musk and tangy redcurrant. Full of energy and joie de vivre, Dolce Rose is an irresistibly enchanting composition. Intense fruity top notes open the composition in a triad of fresh green apple, juicy mandarin and tangy redcurrant. In the heart note, white peach appeals to our sense of taste and opens our senses to a floral bouquet of velvety magnolia blossoms and majestic roses. The unique character of the fragrance is created from a composition of two rose notes: The dewy clarity of a centifolia essence combines with the soft sensuality of rose absolute to create an unmistakable rose fragrance. This powerful note is embedded in a mantle of soft musk tones, to which sandalwood and other noble light wood notes lend a beguilingly sensual quality. The bottle shares its soft curves and elegantly feminine silhouette with the original Dolce fragrance, but now dips its glass in a rose-red colour in which the eponymous blossom seems to glow. The unmistakable flower cap is now also dressed in a bold red colour that expresses the personality of the Dolce girl and the fascinating facets of the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Fame Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Rabanne Fame Eau de Parfum Spray is a powerful yet sensual women's fragrance that emphasises its wearer's multifaceted nature and uniqueness. The fragrance emphasises the playful, romantic nature of femininity as well as its sensual traits. The perfume is suitable for women who like to express their individuality in an exclusive setting. With Fame Eau de Parfum Spray, the exceptional designer Rabanne succeeds in enveloping every woman in a fascinating and mysterious aura . A sensual fragrance for the exclusive moments in life In the top note, the citrus-fresh lightness of bergamot paired with the sweet fruitiness of tropical mango opens the elegant fragrance experience. The heart note brings out the oriental components of seductive jasmine and smoky, spicy incense. In the base note, the sweetness of vanilla and the aroma of soft sandalwood take the lead. This makes Fame Eau de Parfum Spray by Rabanne an olfactory hymn to femininity that subtly emphasises the different characteristics of women. A sophisticated fragrance for all seasons, which is particularly captivating in the warmer months thanks to its sweetness. The extravagant glass flacon in an eye-catching and opulent design leaves no doubt that this fragrance emphasises the uniqueness of its wearer and skilfully brings it to the fore. A highlight in any bathroom.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Phantom In Red Parfum Elixir 50 ml
listings.description: The Rabanne Phantom In Red Parfum Elixir is an intense reinterpretation of the well-known Phantom line, which is characterised by a high concentration of fragrance oils. This Parfum Elixir unfolds a complex, amber-aromatic and woody profile that picks up on the characteristic lavender note of the series and expands it with unexpected nuances. The opening is a combination of fruity plum liqueur and saffron, which creates a striking first impression. At the heart of the fragrance, classic lavender, sage and orange blossom combine to form a harmonious whole. The composition is rounded off by a warm base of benzoin, tobacco, oud and amberwood, which lends the fragrance depth and longevity. The design of the bottle picks up on the futuristic robot aesthetic and creates visual highlights with red accents and a black dot in a red oval on the top. It is a fragrance that has a multi-layered structure thanks to its earthy and woody facets and the integration of citrus notes such as bergamot oil. Fragrance family: Earthy-woody with amber-aromatic facets. Head notes: Plum liqueur and saffron. Heart notes: Lavender, sage and orange blossom. Base notes: Benzoin, tobacco, oud and amberwood. Special feature: High concentration as a perfume elixir for long-lasting intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Olympéa Elixir Eau de Parfum Intense 30 ml
listings.description: The Rabanne Fame Intense Eau de Parfum envelops the senses with a warm, floral-woody fragrance composition that is reminiscent of the special atmosphere of Parisian dusk. Immediately after spraying, a fresh, slightly tropical top note of coconut and bergamot unfolds, providing a pleasant start to the fragrance experience. The perfume then develops a deep, intense presence through the heart notes of sunny jasmine, incense, ylang-ylang and patchouli. This combination is ideal for special occasions, elegant evening events or moments when an expressive appearance is desired in everyday life. The base note of sandalwood, musk and cedarwood gives the fragrance a long-lasting character, so that the composition remains reliably perceptible on the skin for many hours. The full potential of the individual fragrance chords can be unleashed by spraying onto pulsating areas of the body such as the inside of the wrists, the neck or behind the ears. The bulbous, transparent glass bottle with its elegant gold application rounds off the high-quality fragrance experience in a visually appealing way. listings.description: The Versace Eros Eau de Parfum Spray presents itself as a striking fragrance composition that skilfully combines fresh, spicy and woody facets. It opens with an invigorating top note of candied apple, fresh spearmint, tangy mandarin and Italian lemon. This fruity opening flows smoothly into the heart note, in which floral geranium blossoms meet the aromatic warmth of clary sage, Ambermax® and ambroxan. The base creates a profound and lasting impression, unfolding a rich blend of woody notes such as vetiver, patchouli, sandalwood and cedarwood. The fragrance experience is rounded off with subtle hints of vanilla, bitter orange and leather. The result is a fragrance with an elegant and masculine aura that is expressive without being overpowering. A woody-fresh fragrance composition with spicy elements. Starts with top notes of mint, lemon, mandarin and candied apple. The heart combines geranium and clary sage with warm amber notes. The base consists of a blend of woods, vanilla and leather.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: A fragrance bouquet as colourful and versatile as its composer - but with a deep black name that skilfully underlines the seduction of the perfume: Crystal Noir by Versace is an unforgettably beautiful fragrance for exciting experiences in the evening or at night. On the one hand delicate and unobtrusive, on the other unmistakably feminine and intense - the Eau de Parfum Spray delights its wearers with these characteristics. Crystal Noir by Versace consists of various woody, fruity and floral accords . The fragrance bouquet opens with top notes of spicy ginger, intense cardamom and pepper. Fresh and light, this first scent envelops the wearer. This is followed by a warm, feminine note composed of fresh orange blossom and floral gardenia, without forgetting the peony. Finally, a woody aura awaits the wearer, resulting from the base note with sandalwood, ambergris and musk. If you can resist this perfume on your skin, it's your own fault...</h2 The Eau de Parfum Spray is also visually impressive to match its contents: cuboid in shape, with a striking cap and in the sensual colours of burgundy and black, it is waiting to be discovered by you. For yourself or as a gift!

listings.rawTitle: Versace Versense Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Versace Versense is an eau de toilette that presents a composition of freshness and sensuality. The fragrance opens with a vibrant blend of Mediterranean fruits, in which bergamot, green mandarin and tangy citrus fruits meet the gentle sweetness of fig and pear. An elegant floral bouquet unfolds at the heart of the creation. Delicate notes of lily and jasmine combine with the special presence of narcissus and are rounded off with a hint of spicy cardamom. The base note gives the perfume a warm and earthy depth. A harmonious combination of sandalwood, cedarwood and the characteristic aroma of the olive tree is underlined by gentle musk. This woody-floral fragrance is a suitable companion for everyday wear, especially in the warmer months of the year. Fragrance direction: Woody, floral, musk Head note: A lively opening with bergamot, green mandarin and fig Heart note: A floral heart of lily and jasmine, refined with cardamom. Base note: A warm base of sandalwood, cedar and musk.

listings.description: Eros Energy is the latest Eau de Parfum pour Homme from Versace. A unique fragrance with intense sillage and long-lasting presence. Versace Eros Energy is a fragrance for the strong, passionate and confident man, redefining the boundaries of freshness and elegance and embodying the allure of a passionate heart.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Dylan Purple pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Versace takes you straight to Italy with Dylan Purple pour Femme! The summery country is bursting with joie de vivre - and you can too with this eau de parfum spray! Fruity notes will envelop you and bring the typical "dolce vita" to wherever you apply the fragrance. Plus point: Like all Versace fragrances, Dylan Purple also comes in an eye-catching bottle that is a harmonious addition to your collection. Exciting fragrance journey through Italy's sunny side The floral-fruity fragrance character of Dylan Purple pour Femme captures the positive characteristics of Italy. On the one hand, there are the fresh accords of pear juice and bitter orange and the floral accords of rose and iris . On the other hand, there are the warm and sensual nuances such as cedarwood, musk and amber, which represent the flirtatious and seductive side of Italy. The well-known fragrance brand behind the perfume has thought of everything here! The eau de parfum spray is also visually impressive with its characteristic bottle, which is a vibrant pink-violet colour on the one hand and stands for pure elegance with its golden cap on the other. If you already have similar fragrances from Versace, Dylan Purple will also fit in perfectly as a decorative element in the bathroom or on the dressing table.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Dylan Blue Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Dylan Blue by Versace contains the suggested tradition with notes of ambrox. This is joined by exquisite aromas of citrus fruits, bergamot and grapefruit with modern charm. Aquatic accents give the entire composition an invigorating freshness. Black pepper, real papyrus and incense give Dylan Blue a masculine note and a pulsating heart. A combination of seductive musk, tonka bean and saffron gives Dylan Blue a very individual, masculine finish.
